subject: Rep. Peter Meijer just entered the Michigan Senate race
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Friend —

BIG news in the Michigan Senate race: As of yesterday, former U.S. Representative Peter Meijer, Republican from Grand Rapids, has officially entered the race.

**Meijer, of the well-known Michigan-based Meijer Grocery Store family, self-funded his previous races for Congress, to the tune of $1.6 million and has the ability to self-fund even more in this Senate race.** | [CONTRIBUTE NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/56519?t=6&akid=11671%2E878179%2EtXjhRj)
---
This means that the Republican primary just got more crowded: Meijer is the third credible candidate to enter in the past 8 weeks, joining former Congressman Mike Rogers and former Detroit Chief of Police James Craig. It’s clear this three-way battle will pull the field to the most extreme elements in the GOP: We have already witnessed Rogers selling out his former colleagues at the FBI (in week two in the race) to earn Donald Trump and his supporters’ votes, and seen James Craig go on Steve Bannon’s podcast in the hope of currying Trump’s endorsement. We should expect Peter Meijer to similarly make healthy nods to the extreme base of the party to have a chance in the primary in August.

While many will remember Peter for his early vote to impeach Trump in 2020, the reality is that he spent the next two years making up for that impeachment vote by taking extreme and party-line positions well outside of the mainstream in Michigan. Here on Team Slotkin, we do our homework, and here’s what you should know about Peter Meijer’s record, and where he stands on the issues:

He has said publicly that he supports a federal ban on abortion and has campaigned on being “100% pro-life” – even in cases of rape or incest. Meijer voted against legislation that would ensure women have better access to contraceptives.

He has stood against workers by vocally supporting right-to-work and other anti-union legislation. Meijer is from one of the wealthiest families in America, one of the 9 billionaire families in Michigan, so it is no surprise that he also supports tax cuts for the rich – including publicly supporting the 2017 Trump tax law which was the largest giveaway to the ultra-wealthy and richest corporations in our country’s history.

**Not surprisingly, during his campaigns for Congress, he took over $100,000 from the DeVos family, likely because he supports their crusade to destroy public education in America — and for his support for Trump’s tax cuts for the ultra-wealthy.**

This is a big moment of inflection in the campaign. We have the full range of voices in the Republican Party — so it’s time for our campaign to show we have what it takes to compete and win in Michigan, and it’s why we’re asking for your support to continue building the kind of campaign we’ll need to WIN. [_Will you make a split donation between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project now? Every contribution in these first 24 hours following this announcement will help us send a clear message about the strength of our campaign._](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/56519?t=7&akid=11671%2E878179%2EtXjhRj)

name: Pete Maysmith, LCV
subject: Today's election: the most important state and local races in 2023
body:
These are the ones to watch: |
---

** **
| Peter -- today is Election Day, and around the country, voters will decide control of a number of vital state and local offices.

These races will have significant impacts on protecting clean energy progress and holding the line against attacks on our democracy. That's why **LCV and our state affiliates worked hard to track key races and help ensure that climate and democracy champions prevail in each.**

These elections _matter_. Before Congress passed the historic clean energy investments in the Inflation Reduction Act (**IRA**), the majority of climate progress in the last decade was the result of state and local action. **Because of that state and local leadership,[more than 40% of people in the U.S. now live in places committed to 100% clean energy.](https://links.messages.lcv.)** Furthermore, much of the success of the IRA's investments is now in the hands of these state and local leaders.

Bottom line: **We need mayors, city council members, and state legislators who understand the importance of implementing climate action and protecting our democracy.**

As a key part of our movement, I'm reaching out to share information about a few races that are important to our movement, and which we'll be tracking closely today. **These races are not only critical for what happens in each state or city. They serve as a bellwether for the 2024 elections to follow.**

* * *
# **Legislatures**
## Virginia House of Delegates and State Senate
Since his election in 2021, **Republican Governor Glenn Youngkin has consistently attempted to roll back climate progress and protections for voters** -- and if the governor gets a Republican majority in the legislature to rubber stamp his agenda, he will succeed.

The governor aims to roll back the state's landmark emissions standards and [electric vehicle protections](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/X6bzsVaGZ3cL/QlB0bCs4OGtwUUJjb255MEZuSGlTakw4SWs4ME9ia1BJWGxmWHRuU1Vkckl3UmxrUXl2aWF2bTNnR0NJWHE4N2lWRUhRUHdKZjI2N0tCRmNuaTNWdVlZc3ZjbVlLbG5MT1MvQ3pYd0VUelk9S0/) and [pull the state out of the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI)](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/YYbZBy-2gmF4/QlB0bCs4OGtwUUJjb255MEZuSGlTakw4SWs4ME9ia1BJWGxmWHRuU1Vkckl3UmxrUXl2aWF2bTNnR0NJWHE4N2lWRUhRUHdKZjI2N0tCRmNuaTNWdVlZc3ZjbVlLbG5MT1MvQ3pYd0VUelk9S0/), one of the most successful clean energy programs in the country. **Virginia League of Conservation Voters-PAC (VALCV-PAC) invested over $2.2M to help elect climate champions** in the state Senate and House in order to protect the state's clean energy and democracy progress.
## New Jersey Legislature
For years, **New Jersey has been a center of environmental progress.** Governor Phil Murphy has often been listed among the greenest governors in the country, and the state has some of the [strongest environmental justice provisions in the nation.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/gryxfj~NK9HL/QlB0bCs4OGtwUUJjb255MEZuSGlTakw4SWs4ME9ia1BJWGxmWHRuU1Vkckl3UmxrUXl2aWF2bTNnR0NJWHE4N2lWRUhRUHdKZjI2N0tCRmNuaTNWdVlZc3ZjbVlLbG5MT1MvQ3pYd0VUelk9S0/) But Big Oil has used their deep pockets to attack state clean energy efforts like offshore wind, spreading [widely debunked misinformation.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/EZ_Rc9NLr-cr/QlB0bCs4OGtwUUJjb255MEZuSGlTakw4SWs4ME9ia1BJWGxmWHRuU1Vkckl3UmxrUXl2aWF2bTNnR0NJWHE4N2lWRUhRUHdKZjI2N0tCRmNuaTNWdVlZc3ZjbVlLbG5MT1MvQ3pYd0VUelk9S0/) The state legislature has the opportunity to protect these clean energy investments and continue to make progress on issues like cleaner transportation. **Our state affiliate New Jersey LCV Victory Fund invested heavily in this race to make sure we maintain a pro-environment majority in the state 's legislature.**

* * *
# Mayors
## Boise
**Incumbent Mayor Lauren McLean has been a national example of how to be an environmental champion against enormous odds.** She set comprehensive climate goals for city departments, dramatically increased tree cover and protections for open spaces, and passed new zoning codes to make the city more affordable and less polluted.

Boise continues to be a tremendous example of clean energy progress. McLean's opponent Mike Masterson has said [he wants to slow down that progress](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/z9e0fbLXKAh-/QlB0bCs4OGtwUUJjb255MEZuSGlTakw4SWs4ME9ia1BJWGxmWHRuU1Vkckl3UmxrUXl2aWF2bTNnR0NJWHE4N2lWRUhRUHdKZjI2N0tCRmNuaTNWdVlZc3ZjbVlLbG5MT1MvQ3pYd0VUelk9S0/) and casts skepticism on electric vehicles. **Conservation Voters for Idaho Action Fund made historic investments in this race, including financial investments and grassroots mobilization.**
## Duluth
Across the country in **Minnesota 's northern city of Duluth, another incumbent climate champion mayor is up for reelection.** During Mayor Emily Larson's first term, the city of Duluth created its first-ever Sustainability Office and implemented [plans that have reduced pollution by 32% (PDF).](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/6Lg6B~r37kMk/QlB0bCs4OGtwUUJjb255MEZuSGlTakw4SWs4ME9ia1BJWGxmWHRuU1Vkckl3UmxrUXl2aWF2bTNnR0NJWHE4N2lWRUhRUHdKZjI2N0tCRmNuaTNWdVlZc3ZjbVlLbG5MT1MvQ3pYd0VUelk9S0/)

The city is also confronting environmental injustice, starting a new program to remove lead from water pipes. In contrast, Larson's opponent, Roger Reinhart, has [said he'd leave climate action to personal responsibility](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/vNR6feG3kWBW/QlB0bCs4OGtwUUJjb255MEZuSGlTakw4SWs4ME9ia1BJWGxmWHRuU1Vkckl3UmxrUXl2aWF2bTNnR0NJWHE4N2lWRUhRUHdKZjI2N0tCRmNuaTNWdVlZc3ZjbVlLbG5MT1MvQ3pYd0VUelk9S0/) and that the city isn't going to "be able to change the climate." **Results in Duluth will show whether voters reaffirmed their city 's commitment to climate action.**
## Tucson
**Incumbent Mayor Regina Romero has been a true climate champion** during her first term as Mayor of Tucson. Romero helped Tucson become a conservation leader in the Southwest by tackling contamination in water and reducing the city's consumption from the Colorado River and Lake Mead. **LCV 's Chispa Arizona PAC was proud to have actively supported Romero's reelection.**

* * *
# Supreme Court****
## Pennsylvania
Over the last four years, this state court has ruled on a number of incredibly important decisions, including ruling against an [unconstitutional gerrymander attempt](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/KybpT4dEAbQj/QlB0bCs4OGtwUUJjb255MEZuSGlTakw4SWs4ME9ia1BJWGxmWHRuU1Vkckl3UmxrUXl2aWF2bTNnR0NJWHE4N2lWRUhRUHdKZjI2N0tCRmNuaTNWdVlZc3ZjbVlLbG5MT1MvQ3pYd0VUelk9S0/) and rejecting [a Republican effort to overturn the 2020 presidential election](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/Zzb0MPZ2_vtP/QlB0bCs4OGtwUUJjb255MEZuSGlTakw4SWs4ME9ia1BJWGxmWHRuU1Vkckl3UmxrUXl2aWF2bTNnR0NJWHE4N2lWRUhRUHdKZjI2N0tCRmNuaTNWdVlZc3ZjbVlLbG5MT1MvQ3pYd0VUelk9S0/) in the battleground state. **The Keystone State 's Supreme Court currently has one vacant seat on its seven-member body.**

The race for the vacant seat between Republican Carolyn Carluccio and Democrat Dan McCaffery has turned into nearly an eight-figure race, and the winner will likely cast the decisive vote in a critically important upcoming case focused on the state's participation in RGGI. **A McCaffery win would go a long way to protecting our democracy from outside attacks and ensuring climate action initiatives get a fair hearing.**

* * *

Peter -- the stakes today are huge. **LCV 's state affiliates are hard at work and have knocked on tens of thousands of doors and invested nearly $3M in support of candidates who will take meaningful action on climate and democracy issues.** As soon as we have the results, we'll be in touch. Thank you for the support you give every day to the environmental movement.

Pete Maysmith
Senior Vice President of Campaigns
League of Conservation Voters |

body:
Want to share with you why I'm running and what I stand for.

I wanted to make sure you had a chance to check it out, learn more about why I'm running and what I stand for ... and share it with your family and friends!

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government. Did you know that the Farm Bill expired in September, friends? As a district with almost 3,000 farms and some of the most fertile soil in the country, agriculture is the number one economic driver in communities throughout Central and Southern Illinois. **That’s why I’m calling for my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to work alongside me to get the Farm Bill across the finish line and renew essential programs that farmers and families in our district and across the country rely on.** If we fail to meet this moment with the urgency it deserves, we'll leave dairy farmers without the support they need, which would cause milk and other dairy product prices to skyrocket, leave young and family farmers without access to critical crop insurance, and sap funding from nutrition programs like SNAP — which helps assist families who may not have access to healthy and nutritious food. I know we’ve seen partisan games and politics define Congress, _especially over the last few weeks_ , but we must prioritize communities across our country and pass this bipartisan bill that will expand job opportunities, put food on the table, and provide our farmers with the resources they deserve. **[I need a strong team standing with me in the fight to get the 2023 Farm Bill passed without delay. body:
This is what we’re fighting for. Will you please let me explain?
#
Peter,
I’m running for U.S. Senate because I want everyday Missourians to call the shots in our country — not giant corporations or the cowards and phonies they bought off in Washington. **This email is long, but will you please let me explain?**
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38875?refcode=em20231107-4144&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4144%2E614464%2EqX5V6N)**
**When I came home between deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan, it was clear to me that Missouri is on the frontlines of the fight for power in our country.**
While communities like mine all across our state were stripped for parts, corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley attacked workers with anti-union schemes like “Right-to-Work” and fought to block wage increases for Missouri families — all to enrich the multinational corporations and mega-donors who bankroll their campaigns and their careers.
They helped Wall Street financiers sell off our farmland to billionaires in China and Brazil — devastating rural communities and contributing to the closure of 90% of Missouri hog producers in a single generation.
One of Missouri’s oldest and largest employers, Anheuser-Busch, was sold to a Belgian conglomerate — costing Missouri more than a thousand jobs.
Missouri-based Monsanto, one of the world’s most important agrochemical and biotechnology companies, was sold to Germany — eliminating even more jobs.
And as dozens more headquarters have been taken out of state, politicians in power like Josh Hawley were happy to sit back and watch it happen.
**Manufacturing, agriculture, production — they’re shipping it all away to foreign oligarchs who don’t care about working people in our state.** And while our communities were getting gutted, these same politicians voted time and time again to spend trillions of dollars and thousands of lives on overseas wars that got their Big Oil friends rich.
At the same time, these politicians have spent decades sparking phony culture wars to distract and divide our families. They’ve become so obsessed with controlling our lives, they made Missouri the first state in the nation to ban abortion — without exceptions for victims of rape or incest.
**Our state deserves a Senator who will stand up and fight for it, not run for the exit like Josh Hawley — and I’m ready to serve.[So if you’re ready to elect a real warrior for working people to Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, will you please add a donation of any amount toward my grassroots campaign today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38875?refcode=em20231107-4144&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4144%2E614464%2EqX5V6N)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38876?refcode=em20231107-4144&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=3&akid=4144%2E614464%2EqX5V6N) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38876?refcode=em20231107-4144&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=4&akid=4144%2E614464%2EqX5V6N) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38875?refcode=em20231107-4144&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=4144%2E614464%2EqX5V6N)
---
We aren’t fighting the corporate status quo just to make a point, either. **This is a race we really can win.**
Our values have won at the ballot box in Missouri for referendums that go beyond what’s happening nowadays in Washington, or even what political elites in Jefferson City are willing to allow.
For the last three election cycles, Missouri voters have side-stepped our politicians by voting to increase the minimum wage well above the federal level, expand health care, repeal an anti-worker “Right-to-Work” scheme, legalize weed, and enact more protections against political corruption with wide margins.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38875?refcode=em20231107-4144&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=4144%2E614464%2EqX5V6N)
**So now, we’re building a record-breaking, people-powered movement to defeat Josh Hawley and take this Senate seat back for working Missourians.**
Together, we’re going to stop printing money for Wall Street and start funding our schools enough to get Missouri out of last place for starting teacher pay.
We’re going to abolish corporate PACs and demand a government that safeguards our democracy and holds corrupt politicians accountable.
We’re going to take back Missouri farmland for Missouri farmers and start manufacturing essential drugs right here in America.
We’re going to build an economy that puts American workers and small businesses in charge, not giant corporations and foreign oligarchs — an economy that invests in putting America first in the next generation of energy, semiconductors, and supply chain independence.
We’re going to put an end to pointless, trillion-dollar wars and invest in a Marshall Plan for the Midwest — a historic investment in our workers and communities to rebuild our forgotten towns and cities, and to finally start making stuff in America again.
And we’re going to finally put everyday Missourians in charge of their own neighborhoods, workplaces, and bodies.
**It’s time to take our power back — and we can’t do it without your support.[So please, will you add a donation of absolutely any amount to my campaign today? I’m not taking a cent from corporate PACs in this race so you’ll always know I’m fighting for everyday, working people in the U.S. Senate.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38875?refcode=em20231107-4144&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=4144%2E614464%2EqX5V6N)**

Now let’s get moving,
Lucas

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASECONTACTJAMES MANETZJames@brycereeves.com **SENATOR REEVES CLAIMS VICTORY IN THE GENERAL ELECTION FOR THE 28TH STATE SENATE DISTRICT** November 7th, 2023: Culpeper, VA - Today, Bryce Reeves (R-Spotsylvania) emerged victorious in the General Election for Virginia's 28th Senatorial District for a fourth term. Reeves has worked as a dedicated public servant in the Army, as a law enforcement officer, and as a Virginia Senator. Throughout his life, he has consistently focused his efforts on faith, family, and freedom. In his victory speech, Senator Reeves expressed profound gratitude to his family, friends, and supporters, highlighting the immense privilege it is to serve. He also reaffirmed his dedication to the principles of limited government, lower taxes, and individual freedoms. "I am deeply honored by the trust that the voters of the 28th District have placed in me," Reeves said. “I'd be remiss if I didn't thank my family, my friends, my team, and everybody who took the time to show up and vote. I'm excited to return to Richmond and continue working to make Virginians' lives easier, better, and safer." For more information on Senator Bryce Reeves and his continued service to the people of the 28th Senate District, please visit https://brycereeves.com/ ###

Fellow American,

It’s the last night before another debate. This time, the stakes are higher, there are fewer candidates to spout their poll-tested platitudes, and _hopefully_ , less neocon war-mongering.

Other candidates on the stage tomorrow may have you believe that the only way forward is by sticking with what’s been tried before... and what hasn’t worked. There is absolutely another way – to run toward our goals and identity, not just away from what we don’t want.

I’m thinking about my sons and our future generations as I run for President. As President, my sole obligation would be to the citizens of our nation. My foreign policy is built with them in mind:

1\. Avoid World War III

2\. Declare Independence from Communist China

3\. Secure our homeland

I’m running for President because I believe that merit, accountability, and free speech have been trampled on for years – our American identity has suffered for it and it’s time to restore and unite around these ideals. Our fundamental principles are worth fighting for.

The Establishment’s goal is for you to forget American exceptionalism and to keep us divided. Our country has fought and overcome adversity before. Our best days are still ahead. I’m not conceding an inch to anyone who tells you otherwise.

I’m grateful you’re on my team. I know together we can accomplish our goals. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** | Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: they're not going to like this
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

If you click on any news station later this evening, you can virtually guarantee you’ll see wall-to-wall coverage about the results of today’s elections.

But it won’t __really__ be Ohio’s _Issue 1_ radical pro-abortion referendum and the elections in Virginia and elsewhere that political pundits are concerned with . . .

_**_Every single one of them is going to be bloviating about what these election results mean for the next one_!**_

As the smoke clears from today, all eyes are going to immediately turn to 2024.

Pro-Life Friend, tomorrow night, there’s another Republican debate taking place in Miami.

President Trump – _who is leading in primary polls and has thus far refused to debate_ – is holding a rally about 30 minutes away in Hialeah, Florida.
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sjtdltk-duchtdja-y/)
To ensure we’re keeping up the pressure on ALL GOP candidates running for President to lead on Life, we’re going to crash it with hordes of pro-life students holding signs with the simple message you see here . . .

**[So, can you agree to a generous contribution of $100, $50, $25, or even $10 to help us turn out as many pro-life students as possible to this rally](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sjtdltk-duchtdja-j/)?**

The fact is, as you know, President Trump has done a lot for the pro-life movement – most importantly delivering on his promise to select conservative judicial nominees who ultimately reversed _Roe v. Wade_.

But more recently, when was asked about the _Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Act_ that Governor Ron DeSantis signed into law in Florida – abolishing abortion after six weeks of a pregnancy – President Trump stated:

## **_“I think what he did was a terrible thing and a terrible mistake.”_**
The truth is, a _National Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Act_ should be the absolute MINIMUM pro-lifers should expect from any Republican Presidential candidate who is seeking the votes of pro-lifers!

I’m very worried President Trump is getting bad advice from campaign consultants who are telling him leading on Life will only crush his political future.

But, over the years, President Trump has proven he will listen to the voices of patriotic, grassroots Americans like you.

Well, it’s time to make our voices heard and burst through the bubble some of his advisors are trying to build around him and **“ _MAKE TRUMP PRO-LIFE AGAIN_!”**

If we don’t, and President Trump becomes the GOP nominee, he could learn the hard way that the folks who knock the doors and make the phone calls won't be there for him if he isn't standing strong for Life!

_And that can’t happen._ As there are hundreds of thousands of babies’ lives on the line.

We must have grassroots pro-lifers excited to work and vote for the GOP nominee and 2024, and they must come in droves in 2024 to defeat pro-abortion Democrats, _at all levels._

**[So, can you agree to a generous contribution of $100, $50, $25, or even $10 to help us turn out as many pro-life students as possible to this rally](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sjtdltk-duchtdja-i/)?**

Your generosity will help pay for the signs our students will use at the rallies and gift cards for students who go above and beyond in recruiting other pro-life young people to join them.

The bigger of a turnout we have, the louder our message will be that ALL Republicans need to lead on Life!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

P.S. – TOMORROW, former President Trump is holding a rally in Hialeah, Florida – just 30 minutes away from the Republican debate in Miami.

We’re sending a team of students with **“ _MAKE TRUMP PRO-LIFE AGAIN_!”** as part of our program to keep up the pressure on ALL GOP candidates for President to lead on Life!

**[So, can you agree to a generous contribution of $100, $50, $25, or even $10 to help us turn out as many pro-life students as possible to this rally](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-sjtdltk-duchtdja-d/)?**

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

The people of Ohio made their voices heard: Our reproductive rights are non-negotiable. Before the Supreme Court’s Dobbs decision, we never even dreamed that ballot measures would become the most vital and likely way for us to preserve every American’s reproductive freedom. Now, we’ve secured THREE victories to defend the right to choose. This win proves again that voters in blue, purple, and red states all agree: Politicians shouldn’t have the last say on what decisions we make with our bodies — we will. = We have the momentum on our side, and it's crucial that we capitalize on it. 2024 will be a monumental year for other reproductive freedom ballot measures across the country — including a major battle ahead in Arizona. = = Thank you, team. This historic triumph is a testament to the grassroots movement you’ve empowered with your unwavering dedication. Knowing we have you on our team fuels our confidence to prevail in ballot measures across the United States, championing and amplifying the rights of all Americans. Let's celebrate this victory, and get ready for the battles ahead. = Kelly Hall Executive Director Fairness Project Thanks to grassroots supporters like you, our team at the Fairness Project has won over 30 people-powered ballot measure campaigns since 2016, changing over 18 million lives by expanding health care, raising wages, guaranteeing paid leave, and ending predatory lending directly at the ballot box when politicians refuse to act. name: Mike Schmuhl
subject: A great night for Hoosier Dems
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Indiana Democratic Party, www
body:
|
---
Peter, We wanted to share a quick update on Election Night. The bottom line: Indiana Democrats had a great night. We flipped some major mayoral offices from Republican to Democratic: Evansville. Terre Haute. Lawrence. Michigan City. West Lafayette. Hobart. We made history by electing more women mayors and leaders of color. We moved the needle in city councils across the state. Hoosiers chose fresh faces who will be the next generation of leaders for our party. We’re building our party from the ground up. We also built on our strong foundations. Indianapolis Mayor Joe Hogsett and Fort Wayne Mayor Tom Henry waged strong reelection campaigns with tough challenges. South Bend Mayor James Mueller was reelected with 73% of the vote and gained a 9-0 city council. While not all of our great Democratic officeholders or candidates won tonight, we are all proud of the campaigns they built and ran. They made their communities better and opened up new areas for our party’s growth. Lastly, the team and I at IDP want to say thank you. I know we send out a lot of emails asking for your support and donations. All of that support leads to these moments. Because of your investments in our party, we’ve been able to help make these gains so thousands more Hoosiers will have a Democratic mayor or a city council member next year than they do now. Some days it can be hard to be a Democrat in Indiana. I’m proud of our candidates, their teams and families, our volunteers, and Hoosier voters who made tonight possible. _**[We’ll share more tomorrow – and would sincerely appreciate a donation to make sure we can build on these results into 2024.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72986386/437052400/405560545?refcode=2311107Updates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZjZlODQyZi1lZTdkLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kJhBAHorv1QsJw0fI8hP60_fbLBCk2TYg0zg9P1doMA=)**_ Thank you again for all of your support.

subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvlc3u3afrk7iklrv43scdup2vs30fcgmjo3kqr8_rp22sh2s8i66p74s5j6eor2c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zef07onats2o7bquagp49mh6ifopq2q1grbidf4o_rp22sh2s8i66p74s5j6eor2c3h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zudt8gtf87bgva7899s9jeo6pq4plor1biesg3bo_rp22sh2s8i66p74s5j6eor2c3h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

| Friends and Neighbors,
We won! Tracy and I cannot thank you enough for the prayers and support you gave us over the last year. Governor Glenn Youngkin and many many others poured their heart and soul into this.
For those who won, congratulations. For those who did not win, thank you for stepping up being part of the conversation. For a better future, let's learn, and get back to it. We are praying for the rest of Virginia. I will "do what I must". More soon...
---
| Take care and I cannot wait to see you around the district!

name: The Exodus Effect
subject: Brace Yourself for the Impending Food Crisis
body:
The real nightmare looms ahead

Sure, we've all seen those skyrocketing food prices lately, but mark my words, that's the least of our worries.

The real nightmare looms ahead, and it's a chilling report exposing the imminent food shortages that should send shivers down your spine.

Picture this: America's food supply drying up, leaving grocery store shelves bare and pantries empty.

[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c673523%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=tAjMlRywVUqhlEdPL9GaDQ&sysid=1)

When that happens, chaos will descend upon our very neighborhoods, and the thin veil of civility will be torn apart.

[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c673524%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BTaVfHeq%2boiZZUrmP8k7jA&sysid=1)

People you once called friends might transform into ruthless adversaries, breaking into your homes, smashing windows, and ripping food straight from the hands of your innocent children.

It's a scene straight out of a survivalist's worst nightmare.

I don't want to sow fear, but I won't sugarcoat the truth either.

As dedicated preppers, it's our solemn duty to prepare for the worst and protect our families at all costs.

I pray to whatever higher power you believe in that we never have to face such a grim reality.

But hope alone won't sustain us.

We must be proactive and get ready for whatever may come.

Knowledge is power, my friends, and understanding the terrifying truth about America's food supply is the first step.

[Arm yourself with the right information](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c673535%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3duFaklb81ZP1%2fvNu7GaVA&sysid=1)

And equip your family for the challenges that lie ahead.

Stay vigilant, stay prepared.

name: Your America
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35100%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=iLg7IF93q5Tivh9769UE%2bQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35101%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=h%2fFuZAMekCQik3oNXAkRvQ&sysid=1) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35102%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eWgHr0znj6gPD%2bLQVNbEZw&sysid=1)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

This sponsored message from GOP Presidential is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zhntsovu18jbdihgmgd5r3quitni3kbggmgj55n0_rp22sh2s8i66p74s5gm2o72cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmos55u9vndmht227461jis7ofvi0oj6m4hmgl28_rp22sh2s8i66p74s5gm2o72cjh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zdvc1a5b6tikln785vpfc5rutm7rohblkcma8ol0_rp22sh2s8i66p74s5gm2o72cjh2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

12/3: [Dodge County Republican Dinner](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xaiidt-didthutlhu-jk/) ** **Waukesha County**
Annual Grazing with the Elephants was held Sunday October 22 with 6 of the 9 Assembly members who represent Waukesha County. It was great to meet and listen to Janel Brandtjen, Paul Melotic, Chuck Wichers, Nik Rettinger, Tom Michalski, and Cindy Duchow (left to right). Delafield Chamber of Commerce hosted a Halloween event on the street this past weekend. Even Uncle Sam joined in on the fun showcasing his patriotism!**** **Jefferson County**
Chairman Brian Schimming joined members of the Jefferson County Republican Party in Johnson Creek to thank its members for their dedication to the GOP and discuss the steps to 2024! **Washington County**
Washington County hosed Wisconsin legislators and special guests, Jim Piwowarczyk and Jessica McBride, at their Pints and Politics event! **Marquette County**
The Marquette County Republican Party held its 4th Annual Freedom Fundraiser Spaghetti Dinner. Attendees were joined Representative Alex Dallman, Senator Joan Ballweg, and Turning Point USA Representative, Brianna Arnold. The event was a huge success! **Dane County**
Republican Party of Wisconsin Chairman Brian Schimming recently joined Dane County at their FARM Training. The GOP's FARM Team Training events are equipping Wisconsinites with the tools to bring victory in 2024, and we thank everyone that came out! **Chippewa County**
The Republican Party of Chippewa County hosted an incredible 2A Banquet held at The View on Lake Wissota. Over 220 attended the event and the event and the was great for "We the People." **Washington County**
Will Martin joined the Washington County Republican Party at their Pints & Politics event. Patriots in Washington came out to engage in discussion with Mr. Martin! **Pierce County**
UW- River Falls College Republicans joined members of the Pierce County Republican Party at a tailgate to encourage students to register to vote. Pierce County says that they are looking forward to the next football season and continuing their support for UW-River Falls CRSs. **Monroe County**
Monroe County Republicans hosted their twice monthly Conservative Breakfast on SAT, NOV 4 and participated in the "R.A.L.I. Cry" [Restoring American Liberty Immediately] exercise presented by Coulee Conservatives. The interactive exercise was aimed at developing four primary campaign issues: Economy, Education, Election Integrity, and Ethics in Government. Members had lots of thoughts to share. **Door County**
Door County hosted an incredible Fall Event with Senator Ron Johnson, Chairman Brian Schimming, State Senator Andre Jacque, and State Assemblyman Joel Kitchens. **Green County**
There was a great turnout at Green County's Monthly Membership Meeting! Members gathered to listen to U.S. Senate Candidate, Stacy Klein. **Milwaukee County**
Milwaukee County Republican Party held two election workshops in late October. Dedicated conservatives showed up to learn how they could best effect change in their communities come 2024. **Kewaunee County**
The Republican Party of Kewaunee had an awesome turnout at their luncheon in Luxemburg. Senator Ron Johnson, State Senator Andre Jacque, and State Representative Joel Kitchens joined members and gave presentations. Get to Know Ron DeSantis

Ron DeSantis comes from
blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to
him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the
Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate
degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was
so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered
to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a
life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and
now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting
to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in
this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every
turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and
consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his
life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and
3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that
this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents
face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political
agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has
promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected
bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to
children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by
immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our
southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the
mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring
our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on
track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record
speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment,
politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the
legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his
leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has
stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next
President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill
for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for
President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the
decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for
another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act
is now.

name: The Exodus Effect
subject: Brace Yourself for the Impending Food Crisis
body:
The real nightmare looms ahead

Sure, we've all seen those skyrocketing food prices lately, but mark my words, that's the least of our worries.
The real nightmare looms ahead, and it's a chilling report exposing the imminent food shortages that should send shivers down your spine.
Picture this: America's food supply drying up, leaving grocery store shelves bare and pantries empty.
[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=599047eeb16948d0a6b6f177fec111c1&_e=iqaNbPK_NekrHv4MS9JlrHnf1CMMktA3RKJ6q3RggVCbvhJfDhkAhCp1UsWMwh2xiNiCg3qxxUeqCoxQzr-GgryDfEsjwk0zP10rW4fHqnznttgcFOAgLHPINBlMuWJ5JjNrNeMTGsNCutQ5FOY0fPMz7VFfpPGIu4-v6TAqVh6pylAr6DodRZTK2sST2DjxvuCSuA51qhHTGDGMjAK0TaF5MlYyS2-YYA4MdVBKLVYSYFgkM3mEMnTFKK3FcDGbGeKXGtKwT6jZT4LrZjLnjgy0kdTrOh4hPMOibBhwnZMEGVOVmDiz91jGcxMzvjTuZEYKwrlZ2glYUi_Gj45qndtNUA7hUq25U_b6zF2ykbqgmKpiYqWrbsgT_hrjFlsNz692hlHeFPcW8_d0PikyYx7FX9x0gdAkG2l2OkgO6yI%3D)
When that happens, chaos will descend upon our very neighborhoods, and the thin veil of civility will be torn apart.
[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=599047eeb16948d0a6b6f177fec111c1&_e=iqaNbPK_NekrHv4MS9JlrHnf1CMMktA3RKJ6q3RggVCbvhJfDhkAhCp1UsWMwh2xiNiCg3qxxUeqCoxQzr-GgryDfEsjwk0zP10rW4fHqnznttgcFOAgLHPINBlMuWJ5JjNrNeMTGsNCutQ5FOY0fPMz7VFfpPGIu4-v6TAqVh6pylAr6DodRZTK2sST2DjxvuCSuA51qhHTGDGMjAK0TaF5MlYyS2-YYA4MdVBKLVYSYFgkM3mEMnTFKK3FcDGbwtlIwTgObnftpMd2zj2oVG363Atl900fMtZXYLuaI18fcHFD1arYxStcGFtGGgyV3cwsEomOBfZ48MPPjIGpOweAvnxuKXR4z-9BT9G30fVK7LaeZx6ZJdPpDyD9U1hp1NLoCOnuNn4_phJGoadeRVO0xmOfBiJ6ogmiO_1V9JU%3D)
People you once called friends might transform into ruthless adversaries, breaking into your homes, smashing windows, and ripping food straight from the hands of your innocent children.

## U.S. Credit Card Debt Hits Record High
America's total credit card debt [hit $1.08 trillion in the third quarter](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAURb8Gb1jmgW08MHTxlq4dLQzP8aswpEDi5u-rZO56dXV0dL4uy8VSoHj9tAeauqXFukoPXITgmoNcVOPNhggoGzRimCalRj1BsxtYFfZ6A9RaDMpvE2pn1ehHUN0kwTVkoAMpRKdF16t-bIVUSg4WevAKJxiY6tBTTbn9ThTrjlt4pgfm1qWjCWav9VaY_GAwM5jP82y39LveC0Us5fVhMKNLMR1PBrPLLxZ3Nnvuca18p1p4xJNndOk9Boo_d4yOsHAbSuKZCjbZ-NtJIVAZRqa662EpvA3qvz3-AgAA__8exWNP), an increase of 5% from the previous quarter and the highest level recorded by the Federal Reserve. Credit card delinquencies rose as well. Compared year over year, credit card balances spiked by $154 billion as [more Americans carry debt from month to month](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvhSAUhX8NbhjuBUUGhi5ur2tHg3B98oJikD7Tf9_YufM5-c7J9_WYHi6muD8_3Ua2LnlyvsY3TQB84Cgn1QS7ECHJhiz0xiilB4PNap0xXnRBzZ1Qg_EShkXr0M-wLB40URMtCpQAYgDRqU63IJWSvcMOgyKDPVOCQqy5tK8c97rSkn7ym0rr89Yku9Z6nEx-MBwZjtd1tX6f_R0yHG80wxGA4Sg0w9GXm8W9K4HPLrnd08lf39vBa-Zw3ANi4LXElGLeeSGfS-BrvvhF_JkrX6lQu9YtNcWG47p7Z6-ZEs_NxfT3qf5r6DcAAP__3O5mdw) or fall behind on payments in the face of higher prices for food, gas, and housing. After taking inflation into account, WalletHub says the current credit card debt isn't quite the highest in history. Adjusted for inflation, that would be [the fourth quarter of 2008](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7Fu7CAQQNGvgc4rGMZgFxSvodvXprSwZ7wQ4cWy8a7y91FSp77F1fm4T_eYS34-_seNfVvrFJeWXzxp3Q0dmAkl-ZUZ2Ej22o4johtGkMmzZqR5pmjJcLToFtePs1oGsjRoXmX2oMBorQateuzdTRtEYyP0QMgjWIGKKbd63D5rfrbEa_mqLz5uS91k8am1_RTmn4AgILxjKdzSNf9UAYHpEhBIQEj1OjnVQh3x3LqD93o0AUGDctDLw9P-zqXk0zqB6rHFXH4P7U_vdwAAAP__bWRV6g), during the global financial crisis.
## Third GOP Debate Set for Tonight on NBC
The third GOP presidential debate takes place tonight in Miami. [Only five candidates](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ_G7ohgF4wpKL4mXb72Souw63hP-EeYS3Rvf8rVV46mGc3HbbolKbI9_qeVY5v3KeUmT56MUaMCnGxPcWYGxp6jGUKw1o8B-iWO2Q2UCdHiOFskyMZn8HeiQRtvQi8RNKAxejTaWecvBq3FIYEDshxg6KxmkrbXy-cuW1t4Lt_7k-sl72tf4tLacXb4r4NrB9d0bPw63-oNtUku3MG1LVJJVT6-7kVy2tRR-RTirUkqivieGqucNhJKjU_lAgUD7ALORN5xgFFnj45htjmh7muk4yWlyDn4zurHmqT8BrU_9_wEAAD__zQMZTw) will be on stage this time: Ron DeSantis, Nikki Haley, Vivek Ramaswamy, Chris Christie, and Tim Scott. Missing are Mike Pence, who dropped out last week, along with Doug Burghum, who didn't poll well enough to qualify. Donald Trump did qualify, but [he'll skip this debate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vhSAUQH8Nbhi4fCgDQxe217WjQbg-b4NilDzTf9-8zt1Pck7O12N6RCq0Pz_jhr4tdYqp0QsnKfnIQU26y35BBFQdemmd03oYHXSrT4uYLRo9WjHIpJPRRqZZ5CFK52btOvIgQEkpRimMNkMvldbKRjCQNTqwTAvM1OrZf1fa24pL-akvPPtUt674tbXjYuqDQWAQ7vvuj1qoUapvgEHY8b4YhLeFQZCSQRCWQWgrnZk_68GPEy_KuDeKhWecY0Oe4p4px4YXF0KCsU51p8_HTaXQZQemxXOLVP4q2r9PfgMAAP__-vVf_Q) as he did the first two and counter-program with a rally in Hialeah, Fla. Tonight's debate will be the first on national broadcast TV, carried by NBC beginning at 8 p.m. ET. The previous two debates were on Fox cable TV networks.
## First Full-Color Views of Cosmos Released
The new Euclid "dark universe" telescope captured [the first full-color views of the cosmos,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FurDAQQNGvgc7IHgyGwsVrttvXpkQTM4bJGryyJ4vy91FSp77F1Xm7L3fkxOf2Hw_yEvOCQfhFizFqUtAvtl19JALqW_JmnGdr3TRDu3tLU9TRueAiwBgCOj0YDXYCOzs9UcseNPTG6MnowQ6uM721_YgwwGpphrGxmlaWXLqPzKfsFNNXflHpQj7a5HeRZ236fw3cGrhd19XVJwb6qQ3cViwPdaAIFUWfIfGqDq6V86kilyrqvRDKLvjgc1N84Ea1LX59XpwS19E1Vm8Hcvq9yZ_27wAAAP__KchbgQ) delivering ultra-sharp images filled with details and sending astronomers over the moon with excitement. The top-end space telescope can observe areas over a tremendously wide area, almost 100 times more than the James Webb Space Telescope can cover. Each of its images includes over 600 million pixels. The Euclid images released Tuesday spanned [four areas of the relatively nearby universe](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1yhCAUxfGnwQ4HLvhBQZHGbtOmdFCuehMUB3CdffvMpk51itP85v_1GB-OAh3rp9vRliWObi70xFFK3nNQo668XRABVYVWtsZo3fUGqs32UyONa0wHalHYeG1gAjTdJGcpUPcVWRCgpBS9FI1uuloqrVXroAGv0UDLtEBPJab6O9JRNlzCKz4x1XPcq2C3Us7M1AeDgcFw33ed8CqY8vtnMBSctyOGuL4YDPl0M763uMQXCgE9x2sO5DntbsXM83klvlPOFA9-pjgh9y798OugJ6aM_K3lUnLRMRiqZP15UwiU245pse6Owh-s_JvpNwAA__-_HWkU), including 1,000 galaxies belonging to the massive Perseus cluster 240 million light years away and more than 100,000 galaxies spread out in the background.

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1a4a8581a3aa4ac885fa3f1a13595757&_e=CfZFm-ojVAqeRJiidNUieE9_sUjS_ZoDniZRXct4CXYN-xkRPPX4EjBNrgym1irjn5YYe_HZSdat7bE-58QUDhDjyNJh4y3xpp2ILHxl1RmexbCvBewRiL_jrsLHxwlURP3dWs__F0u_tdCgD8tlN2SfD0Qu02LyRs8Hi0DgiC3rvvxbYfbU-xPWaF8Cb_vRlblQij6Jq9JHVqwumyrVQDYiOy19jv1fCHk79l9Oxya8C050ks0Tf4inVnwTM5oR_IdDnidOozVx4cazOyrNzDt8eNMAxLKzkxoWFq0DHOTNltwmOcvEVXm3slvR5yM_hJh7tYoOntiMlLaZbbxPJ5Lhbv7ThuSQFnanCwYE-NEWqN52ACY4vvUpjHq93pd85qo7jPvYM7vrMB6L5oFa7EvRtBRXH9T4yiZuCgkUhng%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars."
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. | | **Take a moment to put yourself in someone else’s shoes, Friend. Imagine this -- ** You live in a rural community in North Dakota, bordering rolling prairies and rocky ridges. You and your family deeply value this access to the outdoors. These clean, green spaces are a big part of your lives. But in December, the Department of Interior leases these lands to a greedy fossil fuel company. In come the trucks and **construction machinery to tear away at the Earth** , install massive **fracking rigs that contaminate local waterways and destroy the land** you hold so dear. This is on the verge of becoming reality. **The DOI is poised to lease 3,651 acres of public lands in North Dakota to the highest fossil fuel bidder!** Your comment before the November 16th deadline can help stop it! **[Please, Friend, fight for the people in North Dakota and help stop fossil fuels from destroying our public lands!>>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2105137?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2105138?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Fracking can sometimes **TRIGGER EARTHQUAKES** and its wastewater can contain **RADIOACTIVE WASTE!** That’s not to mention the ever-worsening climate crisis that fossil fuel extraction -- especially on our public lands -- is accelerating. Bottom line: **fracking is good for no one but the greedy companies who do it.**
The Department of Interior’s environmental assessment for these lease sales admits that there are devastating impacts from oil and gas development. Here are some of the potential consequences for nearby communities in the assessment: **_birth defects, cancer, lung disease, miscarriages, and much more._ [Will you help protect people’s health and cancel the lease sale in North Dakota before it’s too late? Sign the petition now and help us hit our midnight goal of 143 signatures from your area!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2105139?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=bc349cafbd0944b1966068556eacc1ed&_e=AWz-xvnbYDXC5ncT7W-FmqfebYuSFU5jbJKUSgS4ydM_i-dXGntbaKWLBTEI_2YdQdbOYN3-f3WLOxTQuTPdSTUtikkLUWtHXNe5ag7iiCb15VxiDC6lNpwmHKsofmw2EVN-E_YCe4nrmNcfoCpSSK2OzK5lRbZhbbOgXRsxLzyj7DbgxeEuky8OzL3DqEpkbNt9qVRt124MErfVZKoQQOWXhCgnt-e3fbVCOyFHbge1FA69Jy6LO6kAVz4YuI3KZk5eOXw3s0xl5fo-9L2sRWNCrtFV4XQjMqk2_pjMMi8zhaeE8VGkKuzd-C19FQsEx7j1WEuamQfi3lcLAE21xIAghj1scKkog0nMSJG2Y1yzifJsxGjEkQOmoL4VJm-CzKu5vbMz1L_gyDs1wje3APnkXhP2VOJpGhO89T2PCPw%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars."
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis

**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis** **This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_" Food shortages are coming."_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. The loss will be beyond what you can imagine. **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life - depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means you risk becoming malnourished...

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

This week, the Supreme Court heard oral arguments about the legality of the law, which makes it a crime for people under domestic violence restraining orders to have guns. The Supreme Court, with its 6-3 conservative majority, will decide in June whether the law is consistent with the Second Amendment. We need to raise our voices and turn up the pressure. If this law is struck down, the consequences will be fatal for untold numbers of people. Studies show the presence of a gun increases the likelihood a domestic abuse incident will turn deadly.

[**So make your voice heard – add your name now to demand the Supreme Court uphold this law and ban people who are subject to a domestic violence restraining order from owning a gun >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T20ce2cdb-d465-4805-93f4-5bdd25033b9e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

If you’re still with me, here we go.

Peter,
In just a minute, I’m going to ask you to make a donation to my campaign and help me beat Kari Lake in Arizona. I’m humbly asking if you’ll give me a chance to explain why that donation is so important.
If you’re still with me, here we go.
A lot of folks say that Kari Lake can never win. I’ve even heard a few polls have us ahead. Now, that’s great. But please, know this:
**It’s not true.**
Kari Lake lost her last race by less than 1%. Less than 20,000 votes of more than a million and a half cast. She’s going to have more money than her campaign can spend now that she has Trump’s endorsement, now that millions of the MAGA faithful have her back. This race will go down to the wire.
We’re in a good position. We’ve built a strong campaign. We can win. But it’s going to take a ton of work to do it, and it’s going to take tons of folks like you backing us up to defeat Kari Lake once and for all.
Now, look. I’m sure you didn’t wake up this morning, drink your coffee, and think to yourself, “Hey, let’s chip in to Ruben Gallego’s campaign today.” But I hope you’ll consider it.
Arizona’s Senate seat depends on it. Our control in the Senate depends on it. Our democracy itself depends on it.

# Maryland's 6th Congressional District
# is an Open Seat for the 2024 election!
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=c5c4cdb248&e=0a12281e0e)
As many of you may already know, the 6th District is currently an open seat in Congress for the 2024 election, and the political landscape in this district has undergone significant changes.
The reason for this change is the decision by the incumbent Democrat representative, David Trone, to run for the United States Senate in 2024. This change has presented a unique opportunity for our party, but it also underscores the importance of selecting the right candidate to secure victory for Republicans.
After the 2022 redistricting efforts, the map for Maryland's 6th District has evolved to become more competitive for Republicans. The district has shifted from being a Democratic stronghold to a toss-up, making it a prime target for the upcoming 2024 election. This change is a testament to the hard work and dedication of our local Republican activists and the shifting political dynamics within the district.
To seize this opportunity and bring much-needed change to our district, we need a candidate who not only represents our conservative values but also has the experience and determination to secure victory.
We are proud to introduce you to the top candidate for Maryland's 6th Congressional District, Dr. Mariela Roca.
# Meet Dr. Mariela Roca: A Strong
# and Experienced Candidate ☑️
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=9527d7f24c&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela Roca is a true conservative and a proud Air Force veteran, having served our country with honor and dedication in Afghanistan. As a mother of two, she understands the importance of strong family values and the need for responsible leadership in Congress. With a Doctorate in Business Administration, Mariela possesses the expertise to address the economic challenges facing our district and our nation.
Mariela Roca is a true representation of our diverse community, being of Hispanic heritage, and she believes in the American dream and the principles that make our nation great. She is dedicated to working tirelessly to protect our freedoms, strengthen our national security, and create opportunities for all residents of the 6th District.
Mariela's commitment to our country, community, her military service, and her professional experience make her the ideal candidate to lead our district in the 6th Congressional District. She is ready to fight for lower taxes, limited government, and common-sense policies that will benefit all residents in Maryland 6th.
Click below to learn more about Mariela! ⬇️
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=3a0dec2342&e=0a12281e0e)
# Support Mariela Roca: Join Us in the Fight for Maryland 6th! 🫶🏽
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=d75ba1c81e&e=0a12281e0e)
The 6th Congressional District is at a turning point, and the upcoming 2024 election will be pivotal in determining the direction of our representation both here in Maryland and in Congress.
We urge you to join us in supporting Mariela Roca in our campaign for Congress. Your contributions, volunteer work, and your vote will make a significant difference in securing victory for Republicans in this crucial race.
To learn more about Mariela Roca and our campaign, please visit our website at[ ](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=0403b58bb4&e=0a12281e0e)[**rocaforcongress.com**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f84993d76e&e=0a12281e0e) and follow us on social media for regular updates and events.
Thank you for your continued support, and let's work together to bring conservative leadership to Maryland's 6th Congressional District in 2024.
Please make a donation today if you can to help keep us in the fight. 🙏🏽
\- PaulTeam Roca

**Peter,

We are officially less than ONE YEAR out from one of the most historical elections in our lives.**

When I first launched this campaign just a few short months ago in July, I knew this race would not be easy. **[It will take the combined effort of all of us to fight back against the radical left and liberal elites that target battleground seats like this one.](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=4c3e5dd6fda54574a55ee51b80eb492f&_e=wjLrRRAutHchGD3-d6cmbnN6ai15ix_nUh5iwRq-zK02Hw9mt9XriudRYvwtUlRHbjOriob0A3Qc2xMi_FMXANW2rUmKam6bPgqR2Olg5N-hp5msoMdPdITk6y0TIQ7duD8SonQ3gOkT-iC0z0O1FFYygshndUqIBpOrGst4xsnIHUld-4jrBeOSS_lrj8vqktSZPTaNLuPF-ZXNBxlJIb0muwv4G4SG2VZ5ywjmAmZLJJepRm25ca59ngwGV3GdvfRKUk2D9rM-s-GCnqFkAmMIsmz8Opfpmh6EAlQXQdUzXcwuTWI7rchwckk4o1HXkV6vNGD-yLjUIF8vO4hikXlYk68XFvyOEu7gxA0UJDWjUZhl72wpUWbRXrg_Mt2vYg4ilx6IbdKNZ7wL46FvhQ%3D%3D) It could even be decided by less than 2% of the vote.**

Winning this race means putting forth our strongest candidate: _someone who is battle-tested, with a proven record of electoral success, effective leadership, and a conservative vision for protecting and preserving America’s future. It’s a simple choice:_

LISTEN AND LEAD **](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=4c3e5dd6fda54574a55ee51b80eb492f&_e=wjLrRRAutHchGD3-d6cmbnN6ai15ix_nUh5iwRq-zK02Hw9mt9XriudRYvwtUlRHbjOriob0A3Qc2xMi_FMXANW2rUmKam6bPgqR2Olg5N-hp5msoMdPdITk6y0TIQ7duD8SonQ3gOkT-iC0z0O1FFYygshndUqIBpOrGst4xsnIHUld-4jrBeOSS_lrj8vqktSZPTaNLuPF-ZXNBxlJIb0muwv4G4SG2VZ5ywjmAmbUANGWARMNANxMUp_WJyXIeEejHLtuYHVh45-eJ7VO240x-6sJeoYlom4-mDSlrGjM7UzJj669jNL56byBt7W21EzUB6oq2bIQ44rNePqFKJQhZUReuvm1fteJ8mslmgKaL_7u1ys8F9qOxvSNjaDI86WMFUWurLXAO6cDCUEfGA%3D%3D)

ANYTHING TO GET ELECTED **](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=4c3e5dd6fda54574a55ee51b80eb492f&_e=wjLrRRAutHchGD3-d6cmbnN6ai15ix_nUh5iwRq-zK02Hw9mt9XriudRYvwtUlRHbjOriob0A3Qc2xMi_FMXANW2rUmKam6bPgqR2Olg5N-hp5msoMdPdITk6y0TIQ7duD8SonQ3gOkT-iC0z0O1FFYygshndUqIBpOrGst4xsnIHUld-4jrBeOSS_lrj8vqktSZPTaNLuPF-ZXNBxlJIb0muwv4G4SG2VZ5ywjmAmbwBgKfiNBNtsu6OLG_FfdOBrion8-7mtkKT-abHMWD6uQEaR6Ho-t5fQolQZwIhCfe-1dR6dOAxtzlYsIlkWDJURwkta1W6kyhjiVK5yjTyTA3_Msa6Dc3vfIOWn_uVY89lZk37GZcgceWGHxfzwFxYxyqyrSw7iKWdDl6Y8TS-g%3D%3D)

A one-year pledge today puts us one step closer to restoring our American Principles -- that our government and our elected officials will commit to what they will do for the American people. My promise to you and my word that what I campaign on will be kept and delivered once elected.

[**BELIEVE IN AMERICAN PRINCIPLES**](http://links.mackenzieforcongress.com/u/click?_t=e09c1376a1134fb5bbc6c87f9d1914fb&_m=4c3e5dd6fda54574a55ee51b80eb492f&_e=wjLrRRAutHchGD3-d6cmbnN6ai15ix_nUh5iwRq-zK02Hw9mt9XriudRYvwtUlRHbjOriob0A3Qc2xMi_FMXANW2rUmKam6bPgqR2Olg5N-hp5msoMdPdITk6y0TIQ7duD8SonQ3gOkT-iC0z0O1FFYygshndUqIBpOrGst4xsnIHUld-4jrBeOSS_lrj8vqktSZPTaNLuPF-ZXNBxlJIb0muwv4G4SG2VZ5ywjmAmbsXXTMVKVArkA97r__VvhwEphWV0aL54HzDIYDc8-yYaty5TxjZyWK9WiKpCR9ReHsCZ1xvHcmxG27NRYXX7vVrvn4unBozlHM0SoEM1N_vaPhqacclhaUCajJQwIB9Bd3XfyjLSiLk_wGgKUo1fsgQL5UwyRb1YKS5lCJOYeXjg%3D%3D)
**Grow Our Economy**
to protect jobs, cut and eliminate taxes, reduce spending, and stop over-regulation.

**Defend Our Values**
to protect parents’ rights, promote merit and fairness, respect our police, firefighters, and EMS heroes, and build strong communities.

**Secure Our Communities**
by taking on the threat of Communist China, securing our borders, and getting tough on crime and drugs.

**Restore Our Freedoms**
by defending the 2nd Amendment, fighting back against the culture of celebrating abortion, and defending democracy, election integrity, religious freedom, and free speech.

name: Marjorie Dannenfelser
subject: Let our lawmakers know you stand for life!
body:
Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?

| [ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35134%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zDcALxcX3SGEgzW77rvmUA&sysid=1)
---
Pro-Life Advocate,

I'm writing to you today as a passionate protector of vulnerable women and the unborn. I know that you share my belief that every human life is precious and should be protected.

I've been a pro-life activist for over 20 years, and I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of abortion on women, children, and families. I've met women who have had abortions and dealt with the pain and regret as they navigate a deeply felt loss in their lives. I've met children who were born after their mothers were denied an abortion and who are now thriving. And I've met families who have been torn apart by abortion.

I know that you're also aware of the recent Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This is a historic victory for the pro-life movement, but this was just the beginning of the fight. **_We still have a long way to go to ensure that all unborn babies and their mothers are protected from abortion._**

The first step is for pro-life Americans to come together and state what we believe and what we will do in order to protect the unborn. [Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35145%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=VGZCUoEzpMdFoAv2GHmx5A&sysid=1)

When you sign the pledge, you'll be joining a growing movement of pro-life Americans who are working to make a difference. You'll also be receiving regular updates from SBA Pro-Life America about the latest pro-life news and events.
[SIGN THE PLEDGE »](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35146%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=R9PsslrU7UaPgNKI8Qbt1g&sysid=1)
| **I know that you care about the unborn, the protections for mothers and their babies and I know that you want to make a difference. I hope you'll join me in signing the SBA Pro-Life America Pledge to Stand Up for the Unborn. Together, we can build a pro-life America where every child is welcomed and valued.**
---
For LIFE,

Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America

Arlington, VA, 22206

subject: Important Food Shortage Notice
body:
The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis

**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis** **This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_" Food shortages are coming."_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. The loss will be beyond what you can imagine. **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life - depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means you risk becoming malnourished...

Dear
Friend,
Populism
is nothing new to world history. While it can be easy to think
about American politics as being divided between the Left and the
Right, the reality is much different. What we've really been
seeing is two sets of populist backlash against both the Democrat
and Republican establishment.

And
believe it or not, these tensions actually trace their roots back
to Roman times.

That's
why I'm sending you this email today.

I want to
make sure you get a free copy of one of our popular eBooks:
Dueling Populisms by Victor Davis Hanson.

Hanson is
a Hoover Senior Fellow and world-renowned historian, and I think
you'll get a lot out of his insights. Inside this important
eBook, you'll learn more about:

What
we can expect from a political climate ruled by movements that
rebel against both the establishment-and each other.
The
important parallels between these ancient movements and their
modern counterparts in both progressive and conservative
populism.
What
lies ahead for America as we revive these ancient tensions in our
culture.

You can

to contemporary conflicts and challenges.
