Peter,
We are officially less than one year out from the 2024 election.
Our work together over the next twelve months isn’t just about re-electing President Joe Biden and defending our DFL trifecta. It’s about protecting our very democracy and affirming our basic values as Americans.
We’re not up against our parents’ Republican Party. This field of GOP candidates is the weirdest, most far-right, and most extreme I’ve seen in my lifetime. They’re bragging about banning books, attacking the LGBTQ+ community, championing atrocious 6-week abortion bans, and more.
**The Republican Party has fallen deeply out of step with a large majority of Americans. But even so, we have an extremely tough fight ahead of us.**
Republicans are outraising Democrats across the country, and a recent poll from Emerson College shows Donald Trump and President Biden statistically tied in Minnesota.
If we’re going to avoid another 2016 and the four disastrous years that followed, we can’t afford to take our foot off the gas for one second. And that starts with keeping our budget on track.
My campaign team just informed me that we entered the one-year mark about $13,000 behind. We need to erase the deficit ASAP so our critical work can continue without any hiccups.

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

# Reminder For Today!!
# Volunteer Opportunity -
# Wednesday November, 8th 5-7 PM Frederick Location ✉️
|
---
We are hosting our first in-person volunteer event today!!
We will be asking volunteers to help us handwrite the postcard below to voters across the district. We believe that a personal handwritten note is a nice touch that voters will appreciate.
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
We will also be stuffing envelopes with letters to send out!
We will be meeting TODAY Wednesday November, 8th 5-7 PM at a location in Frederick.
Will provide location once you RSVP.
Sign up below or reply back to this email if you can join us today. ⬇️

# Sign-Up For Future
# Volunteer Opportunities ❤️
|
---
Volunteers like you are the lifeblood of our campaign. Your passion, energy, and commitment can make a significant difference in helping us reach our goals. Whether you're a seasoned campaigner or completely new to the political arena, there are numerous ways you can contribute.We need volunteers for various roles, including:
1. Canvassing: Knock on doors and engage with voters to share our candidate's message.
2. Phone Banking: Make calls to potential supporters and help build a strong network of grassroots advocates.
3. Event Coordination: Assist in planning and organizing campaign events and rallies.
4. Data Entry and Research: Help us maintain accurate voter databases and conduct research on key issues.
5. Social Media and Communications: Manage our online presence and create engaging content.

If you are unable to attend our upcoming events this week but still want to volunteer, please sign up below! Make sure to enter what you think you might be able to help with. Register as a volunteer below! ⬇️

# Donate Today 🙏🏼
|

As always, if you are unable to help our campaign by volunteering, fundraising is one of the biggest things we always need help with!
Postcards, envelopes, & everything else are an added cost, and we depend on the generous financial support of amazing supporters like you!

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ted Cruz for Senate**
body:
| | | [](http://trk.tedcruz._zNIkDrh8A)
---
Fellow Conservative, Last week, I joined Border Patrol agents for a midnight patrol in the Rio Grande Valley. **[As detailed in a write-up published by The Daily Signal, we encountered a horrifying situation, when we came in contact with a group of roughly 20 illegal aliens who’d turned themselves into Border Patrol.](http://trk.tedcruz.)** They were mainly women and children – and when I asked them about the violence they’d faced on their travel to the border, words could not fully convey the look I saw on these kids’ faces. One was a 10-year-old girl with a man who said he was her father. But it was obvious to anyone who’s ever seen a father and daughter that these two were not related. I have a simple message for Joe Biden, Kamala Harris, and every Democrat senator: Come down to the border, come out on a midnight patrol, and look in the eyes of these innocent children who are suffering due to the Biden administration’s inhumane policies. My Republican colleagues and I have introduced multiple pieces of legislation to prevent migrants from entering our country illegally – but none of it will ever work while we have a president who defies the law. **The Biden Border Crisis is a national security and humanitarian DISASTER.** Rest assured, I will not relent in the fight to fix this mess and hold the Biden administration accountable.

For Liberty,

From a young age, I knew that I was a little bit different.

I didn’t speak the same language as the other kids. My parents talked differently. We came from a different place.

My family escaped Communist Vietnam when I was four years old, and even though America was unfamiliar at first, in no time, it became the only true home I’ve ever known.

As I grew up, I learned that we owed our lives to the freedoms in this country. That’s why I decided to dedicate my life to serving it.

body:
Let me walk you through how we got to this incredible moment:

| Peter, Susan Wild said I could reach out right away and share the breaking news: **We just got word that Issue 1 passed, which means abortion access in Ohio is protected!**

Let me walk you through how we got to this incredible moment:

**FIRST:** Radical Republicans in Ohio tried to undermine our votes and make it more difficult for citizens to pass congressional amendments. _**But thanks to a people-powered team, we were able to defeat them!**_

**THEN:** Folks from across the state of Ohio worked to turn out the vote ahead of the November election. We organized, fundraised and talked to our friends and neighbors so that we could reclaim our reproductive rights.

**AND THAT BRINGS US TO NOW:** We won! Thanks to folks like you and countless grassroots volunteers, **abortion access and reproductive rights are now constitutionally protected in Ohio!**

Being a member of Congress, getting to serve my community in Minnesota, and fighting for working people nationwide is one of the joys of my life.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=693%2E791427%2EpIIHrP)

Friend,
I'm writing this morning to sincerely ask you to contribute $3 to our re-election campaign — will you give me a chance to explain why your support is so important?
The truth is that being a member of Congress, getting to serve my community in Minnesota, and fighting for working people nationwide is one of the joys of my life. It's a privilege and an honor, one I've never once taken for granted.
But it can get tough.
By far, the worst part about the job is the obscene amount of money it costs to successfully run for office. _Especially_ when the right wing and their super PACs target campaigns directly as they do ours, spending unlimited sums of dark money to defeat us.
That's why so many of my colleagues in Washington have no problem taking maxout checks from corporate PACs, from Wall Street billionaires, or the fossil fuel giants.
**It's because it's easy.**
That's not how we do things on our campaign. I believe in grassroots, people-powered movements. I believe that so long as we're in it together, lots and lots of people chipping in what they can is more powerful than anything the super PACs can throw at us.
But it also means I need to lean on you for support. Especially today. I wish I didn't have to ask, but I know that winning in 2024 and enacting the kind of change our country needs is going to require all of us. So please:
**[Can you make your first contribution to our re-election campaign for Congress today? This campaign is funded by supporters like you giving small amounts at a time, and every dollar makes a huge difference.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-nov23.oBEWmx&refcode=em231108-1-t3&t=2&akid=693%2E791427%2EpIIHrP)**

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Late last night, a majority of Republicans and 22 so-called Democrats
voted to formally censure Rashida Tlaib for her courageous commitment to
human rights.

By punishing Rashida, the House took its anti-Palestinian bigotry out on
the only Palestinian American in Congress as members of both parties came
together to disgustingly celebrate their shared prejudice and
dehumanization of Palestinian people.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231108-rt.LOzvgC&refcode=em20231108-31741&amount=3&t=1001&akid=31741%2E1203867%2Eq7GWmH ]We at Justice Democrats stand with Rashida, now and always. Will you
help us fight back against these ugly attacks from both sides of the aisle
and re-elect her next November by splitting a grassroots donation today?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231108-rt.LOzvgC&refcode=em20231108-31741&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=31741%2E1203867%2Eq7GWmH ]Contribute $3

Before the House voted, fellow Squad members and Justice
Democrats-endorsed representatives like Cori Bush, Jamaal Bowman, and
Ayanna Pressley stood up for Rashida with moving remarks. She then gave a
powerful speech in defense of her calls for a ceasefire and release of
hostages:

“I am the only Palestinian American serving in Congress, and my
perspective is needed here now more than ever. I will not be silenced and
I will not let anyone distort my words.

I can’t believe I have to say this, but Palestinian people are not
disposable. We are human beings just like anyone else. The cries of the
Palestinian and Israeli children sound no different to me.”

Instead of working together to save lives as the Palestinian casualty
count surpasses 10,000 people (including more than 4,000 children) in just
one month, these 22 Democrats shamefully chose to focus on silencing their
colleague:

Steve Cohen, Jim Costa, Angie Craig, Don Davis, Lois Frankel, Jared
Golden, Dan Goldman, Josh Gottheimer, Greg Landsman, Susie Lee, Kathy
Manning, Jared Moskowitz, Wiley Nickel, Chris Pappas, Marie Gluesenkamp
Perez, Pat Ryan, Brad Schneider, Kim Schrier, Darren Soto, Ritchie Torres,
Debbie Wasserman Schultz, and Frederica Wilson.

Make no mistake: this fight to punish Rashida is based on blatant lies and
racist, Islamophobic talking points. It’s telling that they chose to
censure Rashida’s call for peace and freedom in Palestine, but not:

* Republican Max Miller, who said Gaza would be turned into a “parking
lot.”
* Republican Brian Mast, who compared Palestinians to Nazis.
* Republican Ryan Zinke, who introduced a bill to expel Palestinians
from the United States.

While Republicans and moderate Democrats try to paint Rashida as a fringe
extremist, the majority of people in the United States and 71% of Michigan
Democrats stand with her on the right side of history in support of a
ceasefire.

As the ONLY Palestinian American in Congress, we need Rashida’s
perspective, representation, and courage now more than ever, and Justice
Democrats will do everything in our power to re-elect her one year from
now.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231108-rt.LOzvgC&refcode=em20231108-31741&amount=3&t=1021&akid=31741%2E1203867%2Eq7GWmH ]But we can’t do it without you. I know we’ve asked for a lot lately,

Alexandra Rojas

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

name: Greta Kemp Martin
subject: Thank you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Greta Martin for AG
body:
Peter,

Yesterday's election may not have turned out the way we hoped, but I am so grateful for everything this team has done.

To Mississippi - thank you for an incredible experience. You are destined for better, brighter days.

To my friends, family, & supporters - there are no words to express the gratitude I feel today. This is not the outcome we wanted, but we will continue to push forward. I love you all.

I am so proud of these last few months. I do not regret a single minute or decision to run on what I believe & talk about issues that need to be amplified. I will continue to do just that. My work isn’t done & my fight isn’t over.

Onward,

Greta

clean_body: Let me walk you through how we got to this incredible moment: | = Peter, Yadira Caraveo said I could reach out right away and share the news: Issue 1 passed, which means abortion access in Ohio is protected! Let me walk you through how we got to this incredible moment: FIRST: Radical Republicans in Ohio tried to undermine our votes and make it more difficult for citizens to pass congressional amendments. But thanks to a people-powered team, we were able to defeat them! THEN: Folks from across the state of Ohio worked to turn out the vote ahead of the November election. We organized, fundraised and talked to our friends and neighbors so that we could reclaim our reproductive rights. AND THAT BRINGS US TO NOW: We won! Thanks to folks like you and countless grassroots volunteers, abortion access and reproductive rights are now constitutionally protected in Ohio! Peter, this moment proves exactly what we can accomplish when we work together for a better Ohio. While we may take tonight to celebrate, our fight isn’t over yet. We have to make sure that Republicans can’t pass a federal abortion ban, and to do that we need to flip the House. We’re going to have to fight just as hard as we did to pass Issue 1 to make that happen. We are thrilled to invite you to an upcoming event hosted by Greater Georgia in collaboration with Moms for Liberty: The "Giving Parents a Voice" Town Hall.
Join us next Monday, November 13 as we bring together the state's top education experts for a conversation about the issues that matter most to Georgia's parents, students, and communities.
Featured Speakers Include: Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler Moms for Liberty Co-Founder Tina Descovich Alveda King Georgia State Senator Greg Dolezal Georgia State Representative Mesha Mainor Georgia State Representative Scott Hilton Dr. Randell Trammell, and more
The town hall will be an excellent opportunity to learn about the latest on education in our state, engage in meaningful conversations, and make your voice heard - empowering parents and voters alike to shape the future of Georgia's students.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

name: Tina Smith
subject: My thoughts on next year’s elections (and your thoughts, too!)
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tina Smith for Minnesota
body:
Senate Democrats won big in 2022 by working hard and taking nothing for granted. Millions of people came together to make their voices heard, and supporters like you were with us every step of the way. |
#
Folks — As Vice-Chair of the Senate Democrats’ campaign arm, I’m hyper-focused on protecting and expanding our Democratic Senate Majority in next year’s elections. I could write you a _very_ long email about why we need to defend the majority. But above all else, **we need to protect our democracy.** Whether it is folks like Donald Trump running for President once again to continue his radical extremist agenda, or our stacked Supreme Court taking away our rights and freedoms, there is SO much on the line, and I believe the Senate is the place where we can safeguard our institutions and restore our democracy. Winning isn’t going to be easy next year — _23 Democratic-held seats are up for election._ But we’ve been counted out before — and won. People didn’t think Democrats could win in 2020, but we did. Same again in 2022, everyone wrote us off — and we won. Senate Democrats won big in 2022 by working hard and taking nothing for granted. **Millions of people came together to make their voices heard, and supporters like you were with us every step of the way.** That’s why I’m excited and optimistic about the year ahead and our work to hold the Senate Majority. **Today, I want to hear your thoughts: What do you want to see out of campaigns in the next year? What matters most to you and your family, and what’s going to drive your friends and neighbors to the polls?** **[You can share your thoughts in our Election Strategy Survey here. I’ll be reviewing your responses with my team as we prepare for a big election year!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73023784/437142932/-1930991528?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_SUR_AC60_20231108_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZWZhM2RlZS01OTdlLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wHt6ZruYGnr9unNFmJAuFoik3DV8b4XIdDqG8hU1-zg=&emci=17473822-557e-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=6efa3dee-597e-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=6227932)** | [TAKE THE SURVEY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73023785/437142933/-1930991528?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_SUR_AC60_20231108_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZWZhM2RlZS01OTdlLWVlMTEtODkyNS0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wHt6ZruYGnr9unNFmJAuFoik3DV8b4XIdDqG8hU1-zg=&emci=17473822-557e-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=6efa3dee-597e-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=6227932)

Millions of people came together to make their voices heard, and supporters like you were with us every step of the way. | Folks — As Vice-Chair of the Senate Democrats’ campaign arm, I’m hyper-focused on protecting and expanding our Democratic Senate Majority in next year’s elections. Whether it is folks like Donald Trump running for President once again to continue his radical extremist agenda, or our stacked Supreme Court taking away our rights and freedoms, there is SO much on the line, and I believe the Senate is the place where we can safeguard our institutions and restore our democracy. Winning isn’t going to be easy next year — 23 Democratic-held seats are up for election. But we’ve been counted out before — and won. People didn’t think Democrats could win in 2020, but we did. Same again in 2022, everyone wrote us off — and we won. Senate Democrats won big in 2022 by working hard and taking nothing for granted. Millions of people came together to make their voices heard, and supporters like you were with us every step of the way. body:
Is Nebraska ALL red or does Lincoln and Omaha make us PURPLE? | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ne.gop/n41kepo7ku-12661374?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=d75a834b29&e=25844e23a8)
---
| | Peter,
---
|
---
|
---
> **Can a Blue City Become a Big Red City?** The simple answer is...Heck Yes! When we govern like a conservative at the local level, address the fraud in our elections head on, and proactively connect to new voters and make a voter turnout plan by attracting historically “Non Republican” voters...THEN, and only then will you truly become a Red City. In 2022, the nation was looking for a “Red Wave” as polling was showing a dominant “Red Victory.” What happened across the nation was an election that fell flat. Nebraska performed better than most states for conservative wins, but on the whole, the level of success expected across the nation was disappointing. Interestingly, there was one place where a Red shift overwhelmingly happened...Florida! Within Florida, the politically unthinkable happened. Miami Dade County, a given blue county and city (Miami), went to the RIGHT for the first time in decades. How? 2022 Miami gives us hints at what must be done to achieve a real “Red” surge here in Nebraska (especially in our urban centers). Miami Dade had been going blue for years. In 2008, John McCain lost by 16 points. In 2012, Mitt Romney lost by 24 points. In 2016, when President Trump was elected nationally, he lost by a whopping 29 points in Miami Dade. Although President Bush was elected and popular the first time around, the lack of strong conservative leadership paved the way for a generation of blue in the Miami Dade area. Once Miami Dade got a taste of President Trump’s policies, he lost by just 7 points in the very next election! A 22 point flip in one election is quite amazing for a solid blue district. The Florida governor’s race saw the same trajectory.
> In 2006, a Republican lost by 8 points.
> In 2010, a Republican lost by 14 points.
> In 2014, a Republican lost by 18 points.
> In 2018, a whopping 21 points loss in Miami by Ron DeSantis.
> However in 2022, after Governor DeSantis received four years to govern, Miami Dade flipped and he won by 11 points. A full 32 point swing! As the graph above indicates, the Republican Party of Florida was extremely focused as well on voter registration and Republican turnout. There are two big lessons to learn from Florida. One, clean up your election laws and secure your elections. Two, govern like a Constitutional and Platform Republican (CPR for short). “Softer Messaging and governing on the issues” was not the approach by President Trump or Governor DeSantis. **Stronger governing was.** If we proactively implement these concepts in our bluer towns like _Omaha and Lincoln,_ our state could return to a stronger shade of red too. This is why Republicans focused on stronger governing leaders for the state house. Leadership matters and creates results in the legislature. Compromising conservative governing principles will lead to a concession on our values and Democrats capitalize on that. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. body:
Members of Congress are demanding action. | | | Peter, Last week, a group of 45 Members of Congress, including Katie Porter, Rashida Tlaib, and Barbara Lee, signed a letter to President Biden urging him to use every available tool to protect DACA recipients in the wake of the latest negative court decision from Judge Hanen. Congress is finally waking up to the urgency of this moment, and now we have momentum on our side. But band-aid solutions from the President’s desk don’t go far enough. That’s what DACA was, and it’s why the program is so vulnerable to attacks from far-right politicians and conservative courts. What we really need are permanent protections. Congressional inaction has led us to this moment, so the time is now to push Congress and President Biden to FINALLY deliver a pathway to citizenship __ for DACA recipients and ALL undocumented people _._ Our community is promised permanent protections every year, and Congress has failed to deliver time and time again. **We need to turn these policies into reality — and the clock is ticking with DACA likely headed to the Supreme Court. It’s been over 20 years since the _DREAM Act_ was introduced in 2001 — and we haven’t seen any progress on it since.
Since then, we’ve faced no shortage of hardships and attacks — including the rapid expansion of agencies like ICE and CBP tasked with separating families and instilling fear and uncertainty in our communities.
But immigrant youth responded at every turn. We’ve led campaigns to win and protect policies like DACA, which at its height protected over 800,000 young people from the threat of deportation.
**Now with DACA in imminent danger, there’s an urgent need for permanent solutions.**
It’s up to President Biden and Congress to pass a pathway to citizenship for all 11 million undocumented people.
**If you’re able, will you rush a $10 donation to support United We Dream Action’s fight for permanent protections for immigrant youth and all undocumented people? We can’t let this opportunity to secure a pathway to citizenship for millions pass by.**

subject: Be honest… How often do you think of Rome?
body:
A recent viral trend had women astonished by how often men think about Rome.

[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zk2ppfn14fd06j3fdenvpm6e4ei337fp1slko970_rp22sh2s8i66p74s5ge4or1cdh2bs)
Friend,

A recent viral trend had women astonished by how often men think about Rome.

Many men are simply drawn to the wondrous history of the Roman Empire.

However, there is no denying the truth of why many men are interested in Rome lately... **_because the United States is positioned to collapse in a similar manner_**.

What are the similarities between the United States and Rome?
* Crippling inflation and staggering increases in public debt
* Never-ending wars and over-expansion
* A justice system used to prosecute political enemies

If you're not thinking about Rome today, then I want to help you by sending you a copy of my book, _Are We Rome?_.

[By donating $10 or more to the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE), you will receive a copy of _Are We Rome?_. Click here to donate >>](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zb2lqv09h4c9cfkvm1jnmkor0ffg7lmjher058vg_rp22sh2s8i66p74s5ge4or1cdh2bs)

[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zm6a4kkfq64ct5kssoaq6o2b2ntmlejkq0cnnb30_rp22sh2s8i66p74s5ge4or1cdh2bs)

Here's why I am asking for you to support the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE):

**_FEE in the Classroom is countering radical socialist indoctrination by going into classrooms across the country to teach young Americans the principles of free markets, individual liberty, and limited government_.**

FEE is teaching high school students about the dangers of big government in the United States as well as the historical context of the collapse of Rome.

Our goal is to teach 75,000 students the principles of liberty this year.

I want to send you a copy of _Are We Rome?_ by supporting FEE today.

[Friend, can you help support FEE -- and receive a copy of Are We Rome? by donating $10, $25, $50, or any amount? And if you donate $250 or more, you can get a personally signed copy from FEE's President. Click here to send your gift. >>>](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmoherpsjofhj7vumebiqullhcr3lanlva97ivmo_rp22sh2s8i66p74s5ge4or1cdh2bs)

**FEE in the Classroom** is a unique program held in brick-and-mortar and virtual classrooms across the country that teaches young Americans the principles of free markets, individual liberty, and limited government.

[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zire63k04n7drf7vligjs7276v3h5lb9a7eio298_rp22sh2s8i66p74s5ge4or1cdh2bs)
This program uniquely challenges high school students to think outside the box to challenge the mainstream narrative.

In a single day, an average of 75-300 students engage with FEE's faculty of acclaimed instructors through compelling lectures, exciting economic experiments, engaging group discussions, and Q&As.

Students learn how the core principles of individual liberty and free-market economics apply to their daily lives, communities, careers, and the state of the nation.

[Get your copy of _Are We Rome?_ today >>>](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmr9jqag7q33htkfv9bsfcbj9jer695u1bhu7fug_rp22sh2s8i66p74s5ge4or1cdh2bs)

Friend, FEE has a long history of fighting socialism.

Before the collapse of the Soviet Empire, I smuggled books (and raised money to support book smuggling) into Eastern European countries such as Poland and into the Soviet Union itself.

I understand how the ideas of liberty can change the course of history.

That's why FEE in the Classroom is very important.

Now, they're building a legacy of freedom by educating high school students.

We're facing a critical turning point in our country. The decisions we make over the coming months will affect the future of our nation and the world at-large for generations to come.

In these trying times, it's absolutely crucial for our community to stand together.

Yesterday, Congress voted on a resolution regarding the ongoing conflict between Israel and Hamas.

The issue of censuring some Democratic Members, most notably __**Rep. Rashida Tlaib, for her anti-semitic rhetoric and inciting violence against Israel**__ has been at the forefront of this debate, and Congresswoman Lori Chavez-DeRemer, a dedicated Republican, has taken a clear stance on the matter.
**Congresswoman Lori Chavez-DeRemer firmly believes that we must stand united with Israel, a valued ally in the Middle East, and against the actions of Hamas and Hamas-apologists.**
Rep. Tlaib’s actions are completely despicable.

She has led protests that incited violence against innocent Israelis.

She has parroted pro-Hamas propaganda without due diligence and without care.

And she has damaged America’s standing on the global stage – calling into question our support for Israel and the Israeli people.

Rep. Tlaib has plainly demonstrated that she does not respect the will of her constituents or the will of the Congress, leaving us no choice but to censure her for her actions.

The decisions we make over the coming months will affect the future of our nation and the world at-large for generations to come. In these trying times, it's absolutely crucial for our community to stand together. Yesterday, Congress voted on a resolution regarding the ongoing conflict between Israel and Hamas. The issue of censuring some Democratic Members, most notably Rep. Rashida Tlaib, for her anti-semitic rhetoric and inciting violence against Israel has been at the forefront of this debate, and Congresswoman Lori Chavez-DeRemer, a dedicated Republican, has taken a clear stance on the matter. Congresswoman Lori Chavez-DeRemer firmly believes that we must stand united with Israel, a valued ally in the Middle East, and against the actions of Hamas and Hamas-apologists. Rep. Tlaib’s actions are completely despicable. She has led protests that incited violence against innocent Israelis. She has parroted pro-Hamas propaganda without due diligence and without care. And she has damaged America’s standing on the global stage – calling into question our support for Israel and the Israeli people. Rep. Tlaib has plainly demonstrated that she does not respect the will of her constituents or the will of the Congress, leaving us no choice but to censure her for her actions. | We need your support to help us hold the line now more than ever. And here's the next question: If Idaho is such a conservative stronghold, why do conservatives get STOMPED in so many races?

I'll tell you why.

So the biggest mistake grassroots Democrats can make right now is to sit by and think that re-electing Bob Casey is a shoo-in.

---
Peter,

Our nation’s closest ally, Israel, was attacked in cold blood by the barbaric terrorists of Hamas on October 7th. My heart goes out to the Israeli people, and to the families of the at least 30 Americans who were killed.

_This attack is a chilling reminder that evil thrives when our nation fails to lead._

I recently joined a group of my Senate colleagues in urging the Biden administration to do everything in its power to rescue the American hostages in Gaza.

**And I am calling out Joe Biden for going soft on Iran –** _**the world’s #1 sponsor of terrorism**_**.**
When President Trump left office, Iran was almost bankrupt. Then, Joe Biden took office and eased sanctions, slashed our nation’s domestic energy production, and offered billions of dollars in exchange for hostages. Today, Iran is flush with cash.

**My message is clear:** **NO MONEY should go to anyone with a connection to terrorism.**
**[If you agree, take a moment to sign my new petition>>>](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/c8e2774da8d4d6d3c3d6b838967d376c/33013/b4d034bf984681523947229f28c3afba/2eb3532a391653a8c3d6b838967d376c/33013)**
We need to show the Biden administration that the American people are watching and will hold them accountable for emboldening these forces of evils in the world.

\- Coach

body:
An example for all of us to follow.
#
Ady Barkan — one of the greatest activists in the country for Medicare for All and healthcare reform — died last week due to complications from ALS.
Ady dedicated his life to healthcare rights after his ALS diagnosis in 2016, when he was denied coverage for critical medical needs, like a ventilator and medicine.
He sued his health insurance company in federal court and won, but the experience left him inspired to make change. **“It shouldn’t take a team of lawyers, an experienced activist, and the generosity of friends and strangers to get the healthcare you need to survive,”** Ady said.
[We agree. Today, we’re launching a fundraiser to continue Ady’s fight. Will you contribute $5 today to Ady’s organization, Be A Hero, so they can keep pushing for healthcare as a human right? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231108-be-a-hero.UNZbBR&refcode=em20231108-5282-P_FND_CHA_M4A&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5282%2E2526796%2EPAcwOj)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231108-be-a-hero.UNZbBR&refcode=em20231108-5282-P_FND_CHA_M4A&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5282%2E2526796%2EPAcwOj)**
_100% of your contribution will go to Be A Hero’s fight for healthcare rights for all._
Months after his diagnosis, Ady was in a wheelchair — but that didn’t stop him from confronting GOP Senator Jeff Flake on a plane about the Trump tax cuts. Ady urged Sen. Flake to “be a hero” and vote against cutting social services, so that people like Ady would not lose access to the programs they needed to survive.
Flake voted for the cuts, but Ady was inspired to co-found **Be A Hero** in 2018, **an initiative to fight for healthcare reform and inspire others to fight for change.** Later that summer, Ady visited Alexandria in The Bronx after she won the primary that brought her to Congress, as she campaigned on Medicare for All.
They then worked together on the first-ever hearing on Medicare for All in Congress in 2019. Alexandria later wrote about Ady for the foreword of his memoir, Eyes to the Wind: **“Ady’s example is for all of us to follow. There is no act too small, no person too powerless, no moment too late to make a difference. The revolution rests in each of us.”**
[Our fight for Medicare for All has lost a champion, but is not over. Will you make a $5 donation today to Ady’s organization, Be A Hero, so that we can keep fighting for affordable healthcare for all?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231108-be-a-hero.UNZbBR&refcode=em20231108-5282-P_FND_CHA_M4A&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5282%2E2526796%2EPAcwOj)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20231108-be-a-hero.UNZbBR&refcode=em20231108-5282-P_FND_CHA_M4A&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=5282%2E2526796%2EPAcwOj)**
Our hearts are with Ady’s family, his colleagues, and the millions of people he inspired with his fight to create a country where healthcare is a human right.

clean_body: An example for all of us to follow. Ady Barkan — one of the greatest activists in the country for Medicare for All and healthcare reform — died last week due to complications from ALS. Ady dedicated his life to healthcare rights after his ALS diagnosis in 2016, when he was denied coverage for critical medical needs, like a ventilator and medicine. He sued his health insurance company in federal court and won, but the experience left him inspired to make change. “It shouldn’t take a team of lawyers, an experienced activist, and the generosity of friends and strangers to get the healthcare you need to survive,” Ady said. 100% of your contribution will go to Be A Hero’s fight for healthcare rights for all. Months after his diagnosis, Ady was in a wheelchair — but that didn’t stop him from confronting GOP Senator Jeff Flake on a plane about the Trump tax cuts. Ady urged Sen. Flake to “be a hero” and vote against cutting social services, so that people like Ady would not lose access to the programs they needed to survive. Flake voted for the cuts, but Ady was inspired to co-found Be A Hero in 2018, an initiative to fight for healthcare reform and inspire others to fight for change. Later that summer, Ady visited Alexandria in The Bronx after she won the primary that brought her to Congress, as she campaigned on Medicare for All. They then worked together on the first-ever hearing on Medicare for All in Congress in 2019. Alexandria later wrote about Ady for the foreword of his memoir, Eyes to the Wind: “Ady’s example is for all of us to follow. There is no act too small, no person too powerless, no moment too late to make a difference. The revolution rests in each of us.” Our hearts are with Ady’s family, his colleagues, and the millions of people he inspired with his fight to create a country where healthcare is a human right. In solidarity, Team AOC | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

| Fellow activist,

**The New Pennsylvania Project wishes to extend a heartfelt congratulations to the voters of Pennsylvania for electing Judge Dan McCaffery to the Pennsylvania Supreme Court.**

Our organization will always support those who seek to protect our rights and freedom to vote. **We are proud to have knocked on more than 18,000 doors, sent 14,000 text messages to potential voters, and made 26,000 phone calls in support of Judge McCaffery this election cycle.**

While we celebrate the results of Tuesday’s election, the work of our organization is nowhere near finished. We will quickly turn our attention back to civic education and voter registration in preparation for the 2024 Presidential election, and continue to provide civic engagement and advocate for participation in odd-year elections.

In 2025, Pennsylvania will once again see crucially important judicial seats on the ballot. The New Pennsylvania Project will continue to center underrepresented and underserved communities in our work.

**You will hear from us soon. But for now, we wanted to reach out to let you know how thankful we are for your support as we work to protect our democracy.**

Thank you,

Kadida Kenner
Chief Executive Officer
The New Pennsylvania Project | _The New Pennsylvania Project (NPP) is a voting rights organization with a year-round primary focus on voter registration, civic education, and mobilization. NPP centers historically disenfranchised and often neglected Black, Indigenous and other people of color, immigrant communities and the youth in our work. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: This violence must stop
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
I wanted to send you a note directly to talk about why I believe there must be a ceasefire to save innocent lives.
#
Peter — this weekend, [I discussed the crisis that has been unfolding in Israel and Gaza](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/IP-ceasefire-petition-em20231108/?source=em20231108-3136&t=1&akid=3136%2E420207%2EG13uYf) with Jen Psaki, and I wanted to send you a note directly to talk about why I believe there must be a ceasefire to save innocent lives.
It’s important, first and foremost, to unequivocally condemn the horrific terrorist attack by Hamas on Israel, in which they killed 1,400 Israelis, took hundreds of hostages, and are currently using civilians as human shields. There must be an immediate release of all hostages, and I am deeply grateful for the negotiators who have secured the release of a few hostages already.
There is no doubt that Israel has the right to defend itself but, as President Biden has said, Israel must also follow the laws of war—what is also known as international humanitarian law.
That is why, as the violence in Gaza increased and innocent Palestinians were denied food, water, fuel, and humanitarian aid, **I called for an immediate ceasefire or at a minimum a cessation of hostilities** and reiterated my call for Israel to follow international humanitarian law.
Unfortunately, these Israeli air strikes have only intensified. Since October 7, the death toll in Gaza has risen to at least 10,000. In the first weeks of this conflict, more than 60% of those killed in Gaza were women and children, according to the UN.
**This violence must stop.**[**If you agree, sign our petition supporting an immediate cessation of hostilities.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/IP-ceasefire-petition-em20231108/?source=em20231108-3136&t=2&akid=3136%2E420207%2EG13uYf)
As the largest backer of military aid to Israel, the United States has a particular responsibility in this conflict. We cannot legitimately call for Israel to follow international humanitarian law and then stand by as thousands of innocent Palestinians die from Israeli air strikes.
I want to be very clear that international humanitarian law does not rely on whether the beginning of an armed conflict was legitimate or not. Rather, it regulates the behavior of all parties once conflict has started—regardless of the justification or lack thereof. It requires the protection of innocent civilians and limits the means and methods of warfare so that those civilians are not part of what is called “collective punishment.”
You may have heard the term “collective punishment” in the past few weeks, so I want to explain what that is. Collective punishment is prohibited under the Geneva Conventions and essentially says that innocent civilian populations may not be punished for an offense that they have not personally committed. These “laws of war” are designed specifically to give us moral clarity and a clear path of purpose in the times when it is most difficult to see clearly.
When Russia attacked Ukraine’s infrastructure and tried to starve Ukrainians of food, water, and fuel, our country rightly called this a war crime. In fact, as recently as August, Secretary of State Blinken urged the UN Security Council to take further steps on a resolution that emphasizes intentional starvation of civilians may constitute a war crime.
Today, Israel continues to put enormous restrictions on the entry of humanitarian aid, denying fuel into Gaza which is desperately needed for hospitals to continue their operation, and even forcing six to shut down completely. Water has been turned off multiple times, forcing many Palestinians to resort to groundwater and sewer water which has caused disease outbreaks and massive humanitarian concerns. Meanwhile, Israel has told over 1 million Palestinians in north Gaza to move to the South, and then continued to bomb in the South. Many elderly, wounded, and children have been unable to leave the North, even if they wanted to.
We also cannot forget that there are still hundreds of American citizens and their families who are trapped in Gaza and have been unable to get out. Many of those citizens are questioning—rightly, in my opinion—whether the United States has prioritized our own citizens’ lives in not doing everything in our power to stop the bombings of Gaza.
Finally, we must do everything in our power to prevent escalating tensions in the region from growing into an even greater geopolitical crisis after last month’s horrific attacks.
I do not think there are any easy answers. But what I do know is that, in the words of Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr., violence multiplies evil instead of diminishing it.****
[**You can watch my interview with Jen Psaki this weekend here, where I talked more about this issue.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/IP-ceasefire-petition-em20231108/?source=em20231108-3136&t=3&akid=3136%2E420207%2EG13uYf)
The UN Secretary-General has called for a ceasefire, along with several Arab States. The United States must follow suit and use our power, our leverage, and our collective will to call for a ceasefire or at minimum, a cessation of hostilities. We must hold our own partners—especially those whose military we fund—accountable to international humanitarian law.
We must elevate the calling of the very international institutions that President Biden skillfully and necessarily rebuilt after they were torn down by the previous president. We must insist on humanitarian aid, including food, water and fuel, being delivered to trusted partners to save innocent lives. We must reassert our moral authority and leadership in the world by being consistent about the application of international humanitarian law, even in the worst of circumstances such as this terrorist attack, and with our closest allies.
**We need everyone’s voice at this moment—without violence or revenge, with compassion for both innocent Israelis and Palestinians, and with moral clarity of purpose.**[**If you would like to add your voice to this effort, sign our petition here.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/IP-ceasefire-petition-em20231108/?source=em20231108-3136&t=4&akid=3136%2E420207%2EG13uYf)
This is a vital, crucial moment for our country to lead with courage and compassion. Millions of innocent lives are at stake.
Thank you,
_Congresswoman Pramila Jayapal_

body:
Over the last 3 months the WAGOP has been hyper-focused on getting great conservatives elected to school boards. | | | [ ](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=e376fece7c&e=6a281f566d)
---
| |
---
| Dear Washington Republicans,

As last night's election results pour in, with more to follow, one thing has already become clear - **conservatives are dominating in bellwether school board races.**

Over the last 3 months the **WAGOP has been hyper-focused** on getting great conservatives elected to **school boards**. 6 weeks ago we identified **36 bellwether school board races** **based on political leaning, geography, voting coalitions, etc.** that would help determine the future of Washington State's political direction and the movement our Republican Party is making. If we succeeded in these races, then it means our revamped messaging and new boots-on-the-ground political strategies are working. I'm ecstatic to be able to say that **THEY ARE WORKING.

Conservative school board candidates are winning 30 out of 36 bellwether races (83% win rate)**, and that number can continue to rise as late ballots trend our way and take the lead later in the week. To put that into perspective, in 2021 during the last local elections, **WA Democrats bragged about a 65% win rate** for their candidates.

This is a positive sign for all Washington Republicans as we head into 2024 to elect common-sense conservative leaders for State Legislature, Governor, and other statewide offices. **Our revamped common-sense issues-based messaging and boots-on-the-ground approach to campaigning is working! **

These common-sense conservative candidates in the bellwether school board races got some or all of the following types of support from the WAGOP:
* Help with establishing campaign strategies
* Fundraising advice, tools and assistance
* Data tools—including precinct-prioritization lists, walk lists, etc.
* Help with developing and implementing direct mail efforts
* Support in developing policy positions, messaging and campaign teams
* Assistance with canvassing, phone-banking and community outreach
* Get Out the Vote support

You can check the results for yourself by referencing the list of school board candidates below, but **here are the top line results:**

\- 30 candidates are winning
\- 4 races are too close to call
\- 2 candidates are trailing

**The list of 36 bellwether school board races** (these do not include all of the local races we helped support, just the 36 bellwether school board races that best determine future outcomes of voter trends and the positive movement our Party is making with our revamped political programs):

Amanda Miller - La Center School District
Anniece Barker - Central Valley School District
Antonio Machado Catano - Ferndale School District
Bill Hauss - Yelm Community Schools
Carmen Weishaar - Odessa School District
Chuck Whitfield - Monroe School District
Dan Peters - Selah School District
Deborah Nesper - Oroville School District
Don Wiitala - Longview School District
Frank Kline - Methow Valley School District
Gary Wilson - Evergreen School District
Gretchen Miles, Joseph Romero, Shannon Burch - Puyallup School District
Jim Grose - Central Kitsap School District
Joan Marie Murphy - Federal Way School District
Jory Anderson - Sunnyside School District
Kandice Merz - Wahkiakum School District
Karen Lesetmoe - Oak Harbor School District
Lindy Mullen Doyle - Sedro-Woolley School District
Melissa Petrini - Highline School District
Michael Cannon, Alan Nolan, Jennifer Killman - Mead School District
Michael Rocha - Sequim School District
Michelle Simmons - Meridian School District
Mike Desmond - North Kitsap School District
Patrick Peacock - Tahoma School District
Peter Finn - Riverside School District
Rich Wesen - Burlington-Edison School District
Ron R. Powers - Sultan School District
Sherri Larkin - Snohomish School District
Steve Wolcott - West Valley School District
Susie Hawes - Rochester School District
Tanya Naillon - Onalaska School District
Todd Snarr - Asotin School District

---
| | There will be plenty of news published this week about high-profile races that happened across our state, but these 36 bellwether school board races will most likely go unnoticed by the media - **and even more so now that the results show so many decisive wins for common-sense conservatives.**

Let's be proud of our hard-fought victories, and let's continue to organize and work together as we fight for bigger victories in 2024.

And be proud that your Washington State Republican Party is starting to fight again. And as these school board results show, **we are starting to WIN AGAIN!**

Thank you to all of our candidates, volunteers, county parties, PCOs, ballot harvesters, and common-sense voters!

In partnership with you,

Jim Walsh
Chairman
Washington State Republican Party

body:
URGENT! Ohio Precinct Strategy! | | | [ ](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=6c1317463f&e=5c740fa3e2)
---
|

**Since Issues 1 & 2 have been settled (at least for now), what are the critical initiatives and important dates for grassroots, conservative, Ohioans to know about? And where do these many initiatives need your help? That's the topic of this communication.**

---
| | |
**THE OHIO PRECINCT STRATEGY**

**CANDIDATES NEEDED!

NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY!**

---
|
If you haven't heard of the "precinct strategy" it's imperative you learn what it is and how it can be a big part of taking back our county, state, and communities from corrupt insiders.

Ohio's political parties have an organization, codified in the Ohio Revised Code (ORC), that provides for 88 county parties and 1 state party for each of major political parties (Republican & Democrat).

Every precinct (or in some counties every ward & township) has an elected, unpaid, representative on their County Central Committee (CCC). These are the lowest-level elected offices in America, and a great way for average Americans to have an impact on how we are governed. All politics truly is local, right down to the precinct level. And the commitment is typically no more than a few hours a calendar quarter.

The Ohio Precinct Strategy was formed to help Ohioans understand Ohio's political structure and identify grassroots candidates to run for these seats. The only qualification you need is to be an Ohio registered voter. It's an easy 12-step process and in many cases if you just go vote for yourself you'll be elected, as many of these seats go unfilled and there is often no opponent in these races.

To learn more, watch this short video that explains CCCs:

On Rumble:

[https://rumble.com/v3stw1m-introduction-to-the-precinct-strategy-1080.html](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=149359b26a&e=5c740fa3e2)

On YouTube:

[https://youtu.be/q43xIxROVHg?si=ncvqJw2jFmmu0Ebf](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=c5921316e4&e=5c740fa3e2)

**DECEMBER 20, 2023 IS THE DEADLINE TO FILE TO RUN FOR THESE POSITIONS!**

If after watching the video you are interested in running, please go to:

[https://www.ohioprecinctstrategy.org](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=ce3ab7dd9a&e=5c740fa3e2)

There, you can register, find more information on filing to run, how to run and win, and what you can do once in office. We also have people across the state who can provide any help & information you need.

If you have any questions, feel free to call Mark Pukita at 614-499-0599 (c) and have a chat. You can text or email him too: mark@mark4ohio.com

**REMEMBER: THE FILING DEADLINE TO RUN FOR YOUR COUNTY CENTRAL COMMITTEE IS DECEMBER 20, 2023, SO LET'S GET GOING!**

---
| |
**A NEW CALL FOR VOLUNTEERS!**

---
|
The grassroots, conservative community in Ohio is coming together into a coordinated, united, focused, voter bloc that can no longer be ignored. It's time to take the next steps to solidify a durable, multi-generational, growing movement. To do this, we need volunteers to help with a few activities. Here's the newest need we've never posted before:

[](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=a3bb58c199&e=5c740fa3e2)

We're kicking-off what must be a massive voter registration drive across Ohio in churches, at gun shows, and in other places & at other events where we have the best chance of reaching eligible but non-registered (ENR) grassroots voters. This is imperative to improve our likelihood of winning future elections. If you have an interest in being part of a team that develops a plan to make this a reality, go [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=a4fc27bbce&e=5c740fa3e2) and fill in the form with your contact information. We'll be back to you in a week or two once we have a critical mass of volunteers. Thank you!

---
|
---
| |
**PRE-ORDER "SOUTH OF 60" PROMOTIONAL ITEMS******

---
|
The "South of 60" project is a working group of OhioFAN in partnership with GFI. Its goal is to recruit like-minded "South of 60" individuals to join, maintain, and further spread the message of life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness in Ohio. Our movement needs younger blood, and lots of it!

Like we've done with both Issues 1, we're going to use car signs & bumper stickers on rolling billboards (vehicles) across Ohio to promote this effort. Interested viewers can scan a QR code that takes them to a form where they can provide contact information and survey responses so the "South of 60" team can get them plugged-into either issues groups (like schools & kids or election integrity) or freedom groups around the state (or both). The goal of "South of 60" is to grow both of these constituencies so we bring more people into our "tent". You can access the survey [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=ba648b154e&e=5c740fa3e2).

[](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=e243cdf8eb&e=5c740fa3e2)

To order items to help us in this effort, at cost, go [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=40f8c29173&e=5c740fa3e2) and fill in the requested information.

You'll be hearing more about this effort over the next month. We wanted those of you who are "first-movers" to have the opportunity to get these signs "rolling"! Thank you!

---
| |
**CONTINUING CALL FOR VOLUNTEERS!**

---
|
We need volunteers to help with other activities. Here's what we need:

##
[CRITICAL: CHURCH & PASTOR (OHIO) DATABASE DEVELOPMENT DATA ENTRY](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=f4d76cb502&e=5c740fa3e2)
As part of our efforts to defeat November's Issue 1, we need help organizing a pan-Ohio, church & pastor database. We need volunteers who we will direct to websites where church & pastor data can be found. Volunteers will enter what they find into an online form we've developed that automatically builds a spreadsheet for us. There is no spreadsheet experience necessary. This is a data entry or data "cut & paste" activity. It's essential we have this contact information so our army of phone callers can contact pastors about defeating Issue 1. Anyone can do this!

To volunteer for this CRITICAL need, please go [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=278d427626&e=5c740fa3e2) and fill in the form. Someone will be back to you very quickly! Thank you!

##
[SOCIAL MEDIA TEAM](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=d07b6f328e&e=5c740fa3e2)
GFI, together with OhioFAN and OhioFAN's member organizations, are building a social media powerhouse. We envision having a world-class, social media team, who develop messaging and messages, post original content developed by the team, and amplify, through sharing, the "reach" of our messages. This will be a well-organized, well-managed, team of volunteers working to get out our messages of freedom, small government, self-responsibility, sanctity of life, and constitutional order, to name a few.

To put your hat in the ring to be part of this team, please go [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=0a0db5d097&e=5c740fa3e2) and fill out the quick survey. Someone will be back to you soon. Thank you!

#

[RADIO CALLERS "BUREAU"](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=b3b5409e05&e=5c740fa3e2) -and- [LETTERS TO EDITOR & OPED WRITERS "BUREAU"](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=11cea14a5b&e=5c740fa3e2)
We're developing two statewide working groups to use the legacy media to ouR advantage. We're looking for volunteers who can (and will) write & speak (call-in radio). The writing will be letters to the editor and opinion pieces ("Op-Ed"). The speaking will be calling into talk radio shows. This is a statewide effort we're already building-out across Ohio.

We're going to work on crafting consistent messaging across the state, so this will be a team effort - you won't be on your own! If you'd like to explore this volunteer opportunity, please fill out one (or both?) of the forms linked below. Thank you!

[**RADIO CALLERS "BUREAU" SIGN-UP**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=b5f14f7b83&e=5c740fa3e2)

[**LETTERS TO EDITOR & OPED WRITERS "BUREAU" SIGN-UP**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=194d853c6f&e=5c740fa3e2)
#
* * *
---
|
---
| |
**What else can you do to help TODAY?**

---
| Today, you can do two things.

**First** , download our new app calle**d GFI _connect_**. It's available for both Google and Android and it's **FREE**.

Go **[HERE](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=30409b019a&e=5c740fa3e2)** to download and install **GFI _connect_** , or click on the image below.

[](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=e08753276c&e=5c740fa3e2)

**Second** , you can forward this message to 5 friends or family members who you feel would be willing to consider joining us. Please ask them to download and install the **GFI _connect_** app, but also ask them to fill out the questionnaire found **[HERE](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=94ec1c88af&e=5c740fa3e2)** or by clicking on the image below:

[](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=579cb0a660&e=5c740fa3e2)

**South/60 • North/30** is part of our effort to ACTIVATE more Ohioans to our movement while the **GFI _connect_** app is a way to UNITE, COMMUNICATE with, ORGANIZE, and EDUCATE those in our movement, striving for constant improvement of our knowledge, skills, and tactics.

* * *

You May Find Valuable**

|

July 23, 2023 - Help Trevor Cain](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=3901424085&e=5c740fa3e2)

|

| **Another Way You Can Help GFI:**
You can help GFI by inviting your friends & family to become part of our **network**. You can forward them this email and ask them to:

---
| [Join Us!](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=391eeb165a&e=5c740fa3e2 "Join Us!")

I'm a part of the Grassroots Freedom Initiative (GFI) network. Please accept my invitation to join me.

Together, through GFI, people like us across Ohio are building the largest, off-grid, network of Ohio patriots. Just click the link below to get started!

Thanks!

614-499-0599 (c)**

Friend -- On Friday's Symposium we will celebrate the work of German poet Friedrich Schiller, after whom the Schiller Institute is named. His work has never been more important than today, when so many of us are experiencing such anguish over the barbaric slaughter of thousands of children in Gaza. Out over over 10,000 Palestinian people who've died in Bibi Netanyahu's massive bombing campaign since October 7, at least 4,000 children are among them. There is such scarcity of water and electricity that hospitals are unable to function, and unless the blockade is lifted, tens of thousands may soon die of dehydration and disease. In the United States, as in Israel, Jewish voices are being raised against the war crimes, even as many are still grieving over lives lost on October 7. There is also the recognition that Netanyahu's murderous actions, backed by the United States, and made in London, are not making Israel secure, but rather the contrary, inciting hatred against Israel, and American troops, putting everyone in greater danger. This insanity has to stop. The question is, how do we harness the profound emotions that so many of us are feeling as the death toll mounts, and transform them into the calm resolve to act from the highest level, not to bring about further division, but to unite humanity on a higher level? This is exactly what Schiller worked on in all of his historical and artistic endeavors. In Friday's symposium, on Schiller's 264th birthday, we hope to present an enticing sample of some of his contributions which will inspire you to learn more. The online Symposium will start at 8:00 pm. The in-person Manhattan celebration will begin at 7:00 pm, and include refreshments and live performances. | [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/nov_10_celebrate_friedrich_schiller?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231110_schiller_celebration&n=2 "RSVP to attend in Manhattan in person") [RSVP to attend in Manhattan in person](https://www.sareforsenate.com/nov_10_celebrate_friedrich_schiller?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231110_schiller_celebration&n=2)

body:
I wanted to reach out directly to say thank you for the help many of you gave.

Virginia, Kentucky, Pennsylvania, Ohio and more...
By now you've no doubt seen the news of Democratic hard-fought victories in many of the big elections that happened yesterday.
Today, I wanted to reach out directly to say thank you for the help many of you gave.
Together, we made a difference. That's something I've heard directly, and something I thought important to share with you, as well.
**You contributed almost $150,000 to Governor Andy Beshear in Kentucky.** I can tell you first-hand, Andy was amazed at the response to the emails we sent. No one over there expected $75,000 from a single email, but that's what you did. Twice in a row.
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/2967?t=1&akid=1655%2E4767699%2ETLEy_e)
**You donated more than $100,000 directly to the Democratic Party of Virginia** where Democrats are now in control of both the State Senate and House of Delegates. Big victories to protect against the rest of Glenn Youngkin's term.
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/2968?t=2&akid=1655%2E4767699%2ETLEy_e)
**You gave — just this week and in a few hours notice — almost $70,000 to the Pennsylvania Democratic Party** where they won key judicial races that will have an important impact protecting against any attempts by Donald Trump to overturn the 2024 election.
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/2969?t=3&akid=1655%2E4767699%2ETLEy_e)
**So far this election cycle, you have contributed more than $2.2 million from more than 110,000 small-dollar donations directly to party committees and candidates across the country in response to emails like this one.**
Thank you.
Thank you to those who gave.
And thank you to those of you who are even just reading this email. Even opening these messages is important, if you can believe it.
Now it's on to 2024 with enthusiasm and the wind at our backs.
\- Gavin

Peter, there is no electoral contest that Democrats can’t win if we work to win them together. **Last night, Democratic voters secured victory in competitive, key races for Kentucky governor and Virginia legislature. Meanwhile, Ohio voters decided to enshrine the right to abortion in their state Constitution.** These victories are just the latest proof: When we commit the necessary time and resources to crucial electoral contests, we can defeat far-right radicalism wherever it appears. **Kentucky and Virginia are bellwethers for our state, Peter. Friend, I am the only Palestinian American serving in Congress. My perspective is needed here now more than ever. **But last night, the House voted to censure me in an attempt to silence and intimidate our movement for peace.** It’s a shame my colleagues are more focused on silencing me than they are on saving lives, as the death toll in Gaza has surpassed 10,000 people. I told them they can censure me, but they can’t silence the voices of the majority of Americans who support a ceasefire now. Our movement is growing every single day. There are millions of people across the country who are done watching our government support the collective punishment of Palestinians. **I can’t believe I have to say this, but Palestinian people are not disposable. We are human beings.**
My grandmother (my sity), like all Palestinians, just wants to live her life with the freedom and human dignity we all deserve.
**Speaking up to save lives―no matter faith, no matter ethnicity―should not be controversial.**
The cries of Palestinian and Israeli children sound no different to me. However, many of my colleagues in Congress seem to hear the cries of Palestinians differently, or not at all. The majority of Representatives have voted to send billions of dollars more to the Israeli military to continue the indiscriminate bombing of civilians—including illegally using white phosphorus, which burns skin down to the bone.
**We cannot lose our shared humanity.**
I am proud to work alongside advocates of all backgrounds in our demands for peace. I am inspired by the courageous survivors in Israel who have lost loved ones, yet who are calling for a ceasefire and the end to violence.I am grateful for countless Jewish Americans across the country who are speaking out and lovingly saying, “Not in our name.”
Two recent polls show that strong majorities of the American people support a ceasefire, including 71% of Democrats in my home state of Michigan.1
With your continued support, we will not rest in our demands for a ceasefire and for the immediate delivery of critical humanitarian aid to Gaza including food, medicine, and clean water. We will not rest in our demands for the release of all hostages and those arbitrarily detained, and for every American to come home.
**I know that, like me, you believe that the answer to war crimes must not be more war crimes.**

clean_body: Each day that passes without a ceasefire brings more death and destruction. | | | Friend, I am the only Palestinian American serving in Congress. My perspective is needed here now more than ever. But last night, the House voted to censure me in an attempt to silence and intimidate our movement for peace. It’s a shame my colleagues are more focused on silencing me than they are on saving lives, as the death toll in Gaza has surpassed 10,000 people. I told them they can censure me, but they can’t silence the voices of the majority of Americans who support a ceasefire now. Our movement is growing every single day. | There are millions of people across the country who are done watching our government support the collective punishment of Palestinians. I can’t believe I have to say this, but Palestinian people are not disposable. We are human beings. My grandmother (my sity), like all Palestinians, just wants to live her life with the freedom and human dignity we all deserve. Speaking up to save lives―no matter faith, no matter ethnicity―should not be controversial. The cries of Palestinian and Israeli children sound no different to me. However, many of my colleagues in Congress seem to hear the cries of Palestinians differently, or not at all. The majority of Representatives have voted to send billions of dollars more to the Israeli military to continue the indiscriminate bombing of civilians—including illegally using white phosphorus, which burns skin down to the bone. We cannot lose our shared humanity. I am proud to work alongside advocates of all backgrounds in our demands for peace. I am inspired by the courageous survivors in Israel who have lost loved ones, yet who are calling for a ceasefire and the end to violence.I am grateful for countless Jewish Americans across the country who are speaking out and lovingly saying, “Not in our name.” Two recent polls show that strong majorities of the American people support a ceasefire, including 71% of Democrats in my home state of Michigan.1 With your continued support, we will not rest in our demands for a ceasefire and for the immediate delivery of critical humanitarian aid to Gaza including food, medicine, and clean water. We will not rest in our demands for the release of all hostages and those arbitrarily detained, and for every American to come home. I know that, like me, you believe that the answer to war crimes must not be more war crimes.
