subject: I want you to hear this from me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ZAK FOR CONGRESS
body:
#

From the first day of my campaign, I have always done my best to be a team player, and my north star has always been to do whatever it takes to flip this district blue, restore serious leadership to my hometown, and ensure that Leader Hakeem Jeffries becomes Speaker Hakeem Jeffries. That is why today, I am ending my campaign for Congress.

Nominating Tom Suozzi is our best chance to flip this district blue and end the toxic hold that MAGA Republicans have on Long Island and Congress at large. I have spent the past five months knocking on doors, speaking to voters, and energizing donors across the district. I look forward to continuing that work to win this election and to inspire the next generation of leadership.

This moment is too important for an intra-party fight. All of our collective energy needs to be on electing a Democratic majority who can deliver relief for the American people, aid for Israel, and support for Ukraine. Tom Suozzi was the first candidate I knocked doors for in 2009, and just like then, I will be doing everything in my capacity to return Tom’s leadership to the district and deliver the Speaker’s gavel to Hakeem Jeffries.

When I decided to enter this race, in addition to wanting to represent Nassau County and Queens, I wanted to show what a first-time candidate is capable of achieving—and set in motion the next generation of Democratic leadership in New York State. We have done just that on this campaign—knocking doors for local candidates, rebuilding the local political party, and talking about Democratic values of affordability and access to a better life to the voters of Nassau County and Queens.

In less than a year, we've shown everyone that a campaign rooted in community, and with sights set on a brighter future for us all, isn’t just possible—it is strong enough to be a top contender. And we've set in motion a new generation of leadership that isn't going away. I love my community, I love this state, and I love what we've built together. Let’s keep going.

With gratitude,

Zak Malamed

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

When Ron DeSantis says he’s ready to authorize deadly force against illegal drug cartel members attempting to cross our borders with drugs, he means it. We’re not accepting any doubt on this front. The other GOP challengers can chirp all they want, but there’s one man who has the proven record to show he’ll get the job done.

DONATE $35 OR MORE BEFORE THE DEBATE ENDS

NO EXCUSES: The DeSantis Plan to Secure our Border

Stop the Invasion

“As President, I will secure operational control of our border."

-

I will end catch-and-release. If you cross illegally, you will be detained until your hearing date.

-

I will reimpose Remain in Mexico. If you arrive at a port of entry on the US-Mexico border claiming asylum, you will not enter the United States while your claim is being processed.

-

I will increase Border Patrol pay to boost recruiting and ensure the Border Patrol has the necessary staffing to stop crossings.

-

I will have DHS conduct a recruitment campaign targeting former military members and police officers for positions at CBP and ICE.

-

I will take action to end the idea that the children of illegal aliens are entitled to birthright citizenship if they are born in the United States. Dangling the prize of citizenship to the future offspring of illegal immigrants is a major driver of illegal migration. It is also inconsistent with the original understanding of the 14th Amendment, and I will force the courts and Congress to finally address this failed policy.

-

I will close the Flores loophole that incentivizes child trafficking.

-

I will tax remittances from illegal aliens, with exemptions for U.S. citizens and lawfully present foreign nationals, and penalize countries attempting evasion.

-

I will end the use of Notices to Report and any government funding for non-citizen travel.

-

I will end the abuse of prosecutorial discretion and parole authority in immigration-related cases and deport criminal aliens.

-

I will work with Congress and through further executive actions to strengthen and enforce E-Verify.

-

I will defund and prosecute entities that aid or conspire to violate U.S. immigration laws.

-

I will seek changes from Congress to strengthen penalties for human trafficking, smuggling, and reoccurring illegal reentry.

-

I will deport visa overstays.

-

I will allow ICE Enforcement and Removal Operations officers to do their jobs and focus on illegal alien entries under Biden’s border crisis and those with criminal records.

-

I will cease funding the non-governmental organizations (NGOs) and international organizations engaged in facilitating illegal alien processing, human smuggling, and encouraging mass migration on behalf of the Biden administration while seeking to reprogram that money for ICE operations.

-

I will direct the Department of State and the Department of Homeland Security to reinstate Asylum Cooperative Agreements with Northern Triangle Countries immediately.

-

I will seek changes to give immigration judges summary disposition authority and require DOJ to greatly narrow conditions for continuance, motions, and administrative appeals.

-

I will sanction and restrict visas of countries who do not accept deportees.

-

I will work with Panama to close the Darien Gap to prevent future caravans from South American and prevent Chinese control of the Panama Canal.

-

I will establish priorities under the Development Finance Corporation to seek areas of opportunity with returned workforces in Central and South America for supply chain nearshoring and cooperative agreements to end migration patterns.

-
I will also seek additional resources for CBP personnel and technology on America’s northern border.
Build the Wall

-

As President, I will build the wall. No excuses.

-

I will use the military to assist the border patrol on day one, and they will continue to help until the wall is built.

-

There are 600 miles open along the US-Mexico border. I will use every dollar available to me as President and every dollar I can squeeze out of Congress to get it done.

-

This will additionally include needed fiber optic security systems, lighting, and sensors for the system that CBP agents need to do their jobs.

-

I will order the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers to clear Carrizo cane and build navigable roads along the Rio Grande for CBP border security operations.

-
The Left tries to make fun of a border wall, but walls work. Israel built a 152-mile-long fence along its border with Egypt. Once completed, illegal crossings dropped by more than 99% year-over-year.
Hold Cartels Accountable

"As President, I will hold the Mexican drug cartels accountable."

-

I will declare the Mexican drug cartels to be Transnational Criminal Organizations. I will authorize sanctions on cartels, cartel leaders, and other entities known to do business with the cartels. And we will strengthen penalties for those who traffic in fentanyl, as well as those American citizens who work with the cartels.

-

I will set up a Joint Counter-Cartel Task Force to direct and prioritize anti-cartel intelligence gathering and actions by our law enforcement and intelligence agencies.

-

I will convene the Organization of American States to announce new diplomatic, economic, and security initiatives to deter violent cartel activity.

-

I will authorize appropriate rules of engagement at the border so that those trying to smuggle drugs into the United States are met with the use of force. Right now, cartel operatives cut through portions of the border wall with impunity and poison our communities with dangerous drugs; that ends on January 20, 2025.

-
And if the Mexican government drags its feet, I will reserve the right to operate across the border to secure our territory from Mexican cartel activities. If the Mexican government won’t stop cartel drug manufacturing, I will surge resources to the Navy and the Coast Guard and block precursor chemicals from entering Mexican ports.
Work with States to Enforce the Law

-

As President, I will stop DOJ from suing states when they enforce immigration laws.

-

I will instead uphold their Article I authority to defend their state against invasion.

-

I will impose firm penalties on sanctuary jurisdictions. If these lawless jurisdictions try to thwart federal immigration law, I will cut off hundreds of millions of dollars in grants to them.

-

I will seek funding to reimburse states who have been forced by Biden’s border crisis to take the direct costs on the chin.

-
I will remove illegal aliens from census apportionment calculations.
MY RECORD AS GOVERNOR

-
Leaders of both parties have talked about border security and illegal immigration – I have acted.
-

I signed the nation’s strongest anti-illegal immigration legislation, making E-Verify mandatory for Florida employers with more than 25 employees and suspending the licenses of any Florida employer who knowingly employs illegal aliens.

-

That same legislation enhances penalties for human smuggling, bans local governments from issuing identification documents to illegal aliens, invalidates ID cards issued to illegal aliens in other states, and requires hospitals to collect and submit data on the costs of providing healthcare to illegal aliens.

-

I sent Florida state law enforcement officers and equipment to Texas in 2021, where they apprehended thousands of illegal aliens and aided in hundreds of criminal arrests for felonies including human trafficking and drug smuggling.

-

I issued an executive order that mobilized state law enforcement and National Guard resources to aid in the interdiction of more than 10,000 migrants attempting to land on Florida’s shores.

-

I secured $24 million to facilitate the transport of illegal aliens to Martha’s Vineyard and other sanctuary jurisdictions, relieving overrun border communities and bringing the reality of the border crisis to the communities that support Biden’s open border policies.

-

I successfully petitioned the Florida Supreme Court to impanel a statewide grand jury to examine international human smuggling networks that bring aliens to the southern border and ultimately to Florida.”

It’s time to shut our border down, put Americans first, and end the deadly flow of drugs, crime, and terrorism into our country. With your support, Ron DeSantis will get the job done. No excuses.

In Freedom,

Dangling the prize of citizenship to the future offspring of illegal immigrants is a major driver of illegal migration. It is also inconsistent with the original understanding of the 14th Amendment, and I will force the courts and Congress to finally address this failed policy. - I will close the Flores loophole that incentivizes child trafficking. - I will tax remittances from illegal aliens, with exemptions for U.S. citizens and lawfully present foreign nationals, and penalize countries attempting evasion. - I will end the use of Notices to Report and any government funding for non-citizen travel. - I will end the abuse of prosecutorial discretion and parole authority in immigration-related cases and deport criminal aliens. - I will work with Congress and through further executive actions to strengthen and enforce E-Verify. - I will defund and prosecute entities that aid or conspire to violate U.S. immigration laws. - I will seek changes from Congress to strengthen penalties for human trafficking, smuggling, and reoccurring illegal reentry. - I will deport visa overstays. - I will allow ICE Enforcement and Removal Operations officers to do their jobs and focus on illegal alien entries under Biden’s border crisis and those with criminal records. - I will cease funding the non-governmental organizations (NGOs) and international organizations engaged in facilitating illegal alien processing, human smuggling, and encouraging mass migration on behalf of the Biden administration while seeking to reprogram that money for ICE operations. - I will establish priorities under the Development Finance Corporation to seek areas of opportunity with returned workforces in Central and South America for supply chain nearshoring and cooperative agreements to end migration patterns. - I will also seek additional resources for CBP personnel and technology on America’s northern border. Build the Wall - As President, I will build the wall. No excuses. - I will use the military to assist the border patrol on day one, and they will continue to help until the wall is built. - There are 600 miles open along the US-Mexico border. I will use every dollar available to me as President and every dollar I can squeeze out of Congress to get it done. - This will additionally include needed fiber optic security systems, lighting, and sensors for the system that CBP agents need to do their jobs. - I will order the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers to clear Carrizo cane and build navigable roads along the Rio Grande for CBP border security operations. - The Left tries to make fun of a border wall, but walls work. Israel built a 152-mile-long fence along its border with Egypt. Once completed, illegal crossings dropped by more than 99% year-over-year. Hold Cartels Accountable "As President, I will hold the Mexican drug cartels accountable." - I will declare the Mexican drug cartels to be Transnational Criminal Organizations. I will authorize sanctions on cartels, cartel leaders, and other entities known to do business with the cartels. And we will strengthen penalties for those who traffic in fentanyl, as well as those American citizens who work with the cartels. - I will set up a Joint Counter-Cartel Task Force to direct and prioritize anti-cartel intelligence gathering and actions by our law enforcement and intelligence agencies. - I will convene the Organization of American States to announce new diplomatic, economic, and security initiatives to deter violent cartel activity. - I will authorize appropriate rules of engagement at the border so that those trying to smuggle drugs into the United States are met with the use of force. Right now, cartel operatives cut through portions of the border wall with impunity and poison our communities with dangerous drugs; that ends on January 20, 2025. - And if the Mexican government drags its feet, I will reserve the right to operate across the border to secure our territory from Mexican cartel activities. If the Mexican government won’t stop cartel drug manufacturing, I will surge resources to the Navy and the Coast Guard and block precursor chemicals from entering Mexican ports. Work with States to Enforce the Law - As President, I will stop DOJ from suing states when they enforce immigration laws. - I will instead uphold their Article I authority to defend their state against invasion. - I will impose firm penalties on sanctuary jurisdictions. If these lawless jurisdictions try to thwart federal immigration law, I will cut off hundreds of millions of dollars in grants to them. - I will seek funding to reimburse states who have been forced by Biden’s border crisis to take the direct costs on the chin. - I will remove illegal aliens from census apportionment calculations. ---|---|---

| | **URGENT ACTION NEEDED: Nursing mama bears and sleeping bear cubs are in _DANGER_ __ of being _VIOLENTLY SLAUGHTERED_ by cruel trophy hunters this hibernation season. [Protect innocent bears from brutal trophy hunters now! >>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2106962?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** Winter is creeping up, which means it’s the final few weeks for grizzly bears to bulk up for hibernation. Over the last several months, these fascinating creatures load up on massive amounts of food to keep them nourished and warm during the long cold months ahead — _**especially important for mama bears who will give birth and care for newborn cubs during this denning season.**_ Unbeknownst to these helpless animals, grizzlies have even more to worry about than the extreme freezing temperatures, barren lands, and long-term slumber from inside their dens. While mama bears are getting in survival mode preparing their dens, **_vicious trophy hunters_** are loading up their weapons and getting ready to ruthlessly _**ATTACK AND MURDER**_ these harmless bears while they are at their most weak and vulnerable. **_Innocent bears and defenseless bear cubs are already being massacred at record numbers by reckless trophy hunters — and as we head into hibernation season, they’re counting on us to protect them now more than ever._ [Please don’t let these precious mammals down, Friend. Add your name now to help STOP brutal trophy hunters from wiping out the last of North America’s precious grizzly bears before it’s too late >>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2106963?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2106964?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
From painful choking snares and leg traps to blowing up sleeping bear cubs in their dens, trophy hunters are out for blood and will do _**anything to get their kill.**_
_In several states, these horrific and tortuous hunting methods are even 100% legal_ — ever since critical Endangered Species Act (ESA) grizzly protections were reversed back in 2016... And now, extremist lawmakers are getting _**even MORE aggressive with proposing anti-bear laws,**_ putting these vulnerable animals at even greater risk of **EXTINCTION.**
Corrupt politicians are working with hunting lobbyists and special interests to try and **REMOVE even MORE life-saving ESA protections** from grizzly bears. Without these crucial ESA protections, more innocent bears and grizzly cubs will be **__savagely murdered without consequence__** — **and we could soon lose this treasured native species forever. **
[**Grizzlies and their baby bear cubs might not make it through hibernation season without our help, Friend._Are you going to sit back and let helpless bear cubs be viciously murdered by merciless trophy hunters?_ Or will you step up and be a voice for these defenseless animals today? Take action now >>**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2106965?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

| | Patriot,

---
I knew the battle I signed up for when I first announced my campaign to take on the darkest and most corrupt forces in our nation’s capital as a political outsider.
---
I knew that the Deep State would unleash the most vicious attacks upon me.
---
But, as I’ve said before, I truly feel bad for my family as they’ve had to endure these vicious attacks as well.
---
**They’ve been smeared, slandered, and subjected to disgusting intimidation tactics.**

---
They didn’t sign up for this.

---
It’s not enough for Crooked Joe and the Deep State to try to destroy me and invoke the “corporate death penalty” upon _me_ ...

---
...They even want to invoke it upon my family.

---
This shows you the full extent of the _wickedness_ of the enemy that we are dealing with.

---
Crooked Joe and the Democrats want to show the nation that these are the consequences of choosing to put a political outsider in the White House.

---
This is ultimately about instilling **_FEAR_** in the public.

---
**The fear that if you stand in the way of their Marxist agenda, then YOU could be INDICTED, ARRESTED, or IMPRISONED for your beliefs.**

---

body:
Governor Youngkin and Virginia Republicans did everything they could to take total control of state government, but the people of the Commonwealth rejected them. Even with tens of millions spent and after every attempt to suppress the vote, there was no way for Republicans to sell Virginians on giving them control to take away our rights, our freedoms, and put the middle class at risk. Virginians won’t go backwards. Instead of extremism and culture wars, people voted for common sense leadership and problem solvers.

|
---
Derek, Governor Youngkin and Virginia Republicans did everything they could to take total control of state government, but the people of the Commonwealth rejected them. Even with tens of millions spent and after every attempt to suppress the vote, there was no way for Republicans to sell Virginians on giving them control to take away our rights, our freedoms, and put the middle class at risk. Virginians won’t go backwards. Instead of extremism and culture wars, people voted for common sense leadership and problem solvers. I’d like to extend a big congratulations to all our Democratic candidates – the veterans, the teachers, the public servants, and more – they represent Virginians. And, special congratulations to the leadership in the Virginia House and Senate who worked tirelessly to deliver this result. None of this would have been possible without our Democratic Senators, Delegates, and members of the Congressional delegation who campaigned tirelessly across the Commonwealth for our victories. Most importantly, thank you to the volunteers, the activists, and the voters who stood up and fought back against right-wing MAGA extremism. The blue brick wall in Virginia stands. Voters across Virginia voted for leadership that will protect their abortion rights, keep guns out of the wrong hands, protect our right to vote, and lower costs for Virginia’s families. Thank you to all the voters who showed up at the polls and voted for our Democratic candidates. Friends, by now you may have seen the results from yesterday’s elections in Ohio, Virginia, and more — and it’s all pointing to something I’ve been saying for years... ABORTION RIGHTS ARE A KITCHEN TABLE ISSUE!
I was in Ohio this past weekend talking to voters about Issue 1 - which will now enshrine the right to reproductive freedom in the State Constitution - and the message I heard was loud and clear:
Reproductive rights are not just a “women’s issue” and they’re not a “wedge issue” either - they are fundamental, and must be protected.
I’m so grateful for everyone who worked long hours, donated, volunteered, and turned out to vote to pass Issue 1 in Ohio; to flip the House of Delegates to a Democratic majority in Virginia; to re-elect a pro-choice Democratic governor in Kentucky; and to stand up for our rights wherever you are.
Your passion and dedication are making a huge difference - and are going to be needed next year as we build on these victories and take the fight for abortion rights to Congress.
I don’t have any asks for you today - just thanks!
Talk soon,
Sara
P.S. We did it!!

name: Wes Moore
subject: I am grateful
body:
Friend,

One year ago today, you made your voices heard.

People all over Maryland put their faith in the son of an immigrant, a graduate of a two-year college, and a US Army combat veteran who had never run for office before. You knew that we could be bolder, that we could move faster.

And we have. Since coming into office, we’ve expanded abortion access, increased the minimum wage, kicked off our service-year option, fought for Marylanders and their families, and so much more.

I am forever grateful for your faith in us and in our mission to leave no one behind.

There is still more work to do — we’re fighting every day to make Maryland the best state in the country to live and work.

Yesterday, voters overwhelmingly rejected extremist agendas across the country. Now it is up to us to work twice as hard to pass policies that align with the values of our constituents. It is what we were elected to do.

The work continues, but know our north star will be always you, the people of Maryland.

I am proud to serve as your governor. Thank you.

Elevate,

Wes Moore

P.S. I need your help to get ahead of the upcoming fundraising freeze in January. Will you chip in now to help us build a better Maryland? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231108-1]

War is always a travesty. [Its horrors](https://substack.com/redirect/178f2392-eccc-4b5f-865b-5873e97b09d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have revealed themselves by the hour over the past month, yet continue to only escalate.
From maimed and mutilated bodies to [entire neighborhoods being reduced to rubble](https://substack.com/redirect/f6f01e16-4247-45e7-b48a-3cd867d419e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the scale of devastation in Gaza is difficult for observers to understand, particularly since Israel has periodically [cut off Internet access](https://substack.com/redirect/b553a549-a1e7-44ef-ad47-ac3242f628e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in order to prevent Palestinians from exposing ongoing Israeli war crimes to the world.
While the Israeli genocide in Gaza might appear far away, its chickens have come home to roost...America is today falling victim to its own longstanding international belligerence.
Many Americans may think our country is immune from the chaos unfolding across the planet. After all, the oceans flanking the United States have long offered a [strategic geopolitical buffer](https://substack.com/redirect/7b60c854-8e3c-4a50-b588-f91f7f7bffa7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). They are a leading reason why the U.S. was able to establish global military predominance, since they kept the destruction during World War II on other shores. It was the oceans that gave government agencies and weapons companies building America's [military industrial complex](https://substack.com/redirect/8ec8133a-09cb-4a09-b3c4-f011533dbda0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a head start on other countries.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6430b8cc-ee91-45e0-88c5-2473c5b4889b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But while the Israeli genocide in Gaza might appear far away, its chickens have come home to roost. From mounting Islamophobia to constitutionally problematic restraints on speech, America is today falling victim to its own longstanding international belligerence.
Journalism is theoretically dedicated to holding power accountable--but editors across the U.S. serve power, instead. You taking a moment to share this post could help stem the rising tide of disinformation and fill the chasm left by the co-opted institutional press.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=138710475&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTM4NzEwNDc1LCJpYXQiOjE2OTk0ODIxNDQsImV4cCI6MTcwMjA3NDE0NCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.kAvHY8W_PMMhhSB6pisE8bL7wWPFIoRvhJCQ1230RfI)
### **Repressing dissent**
Representative Rashida Tlaib (D-MI) is the only Palestinian in Congress, and one of its few Muslims. Before she was elected and went to Washington, a viral video from 2016 showed [her forcible ejection from a Trump rally and admirable defiance](https://substack.com/redirect/8cf49caf-b686-48dd-a2d0-3b6298d8e94a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of epithets from the crowd.
Tlaib was called to stand her ground again this week--this time, against voices including those of fellow Democrats.
The fact that 20 Democrats crossed the aisle to join their Republican colleagues in punching down and left at the one Palestinian in Congress--in the midst of a genocide in which they are nearly all complicit--is positively shameful.
Despite the [constant](https://substack.com/redirect/a8e3a32e-2259-4e12-851f-0fd57ce95711?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) partisan [rancor](https://substack.com/redirect/e10a8d68-b37d-4a97-a52e-702325f40906?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that seemingly divides Democrats and Republicans, the parties in Congress found one thing on which they could find common cause this week: censuring Tlaib for the crime of speaking the truth in the face of their shameful deference to--and active approval of--a genocide sponsored by Washington and Tel Aviv.
In particular, Congress accused Tlaib of "promoting false narratives regarding the October 7, 2023, Hamas attack on Israel and for calling for the destruction of the state of Israel."
In fact, she did no such thing.
False narratives about the October 7 attacks abound. [Many of them](https://substack.com/redirect/19aaa82d-ce92-40ae-b231-2b915abb9de9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have come from Israeli sources [weaponizing tragedy](https://substack.com/redirect/e16fc933-282a-4720-b750-e667ef93b1f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to enable that country's brutal violations of well-settled international law. And nowhere did Tlaib call for the destruction of anything--but misdirection is Washington's stock in trade, so no one should be surprised.
### **Censure is not censorship**
Perhaps due to the linguistic similarity between the words "censure" and "censor," at least some voices have seemed confused about the impact of Congress censuring Rep. Tlaib. They might even include Tlaib, herself.
The _New York Post_ [quoted](https://substack.com/redirect/fddaf7cf-ed8b-422b-ac5e-df7fe99db78a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) her comments on the House floor as follows: "I will not be silenced, and I will not let you distort my words. Trying to bully or _censor_ me won't work because this movement for a cease-fire is much bigger than one person. It's growing every single day."
Ironically, the Post may have done precisely what Tlaib cautioned them against: distorting her words. Journalists have certainly done that to mine more than I wish.
In any case, Congress did not _censor_ Tlaib. That would have entailed silencing her.
Instead, the House approved a motion to _censure_ her, which is an institutional form of public shaming usually reserved for serious offenses. A decade ago, Rep. Charlie Rangel (D-NY) was censured by the House for [nearly a dozen ethics violations](https://substack.com/redirect/1077304c-b4c3-49d5-a699-1e6549c622d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In contrast, Rep. Tlaib was censured based on the content of her speech on the House floor.
Censure does carry some institutional impacts. For example, it would have forced Tlaib to give up any committee chairs that she held.
But since she doesn't chair any committees yet, the censure resolution carries limited impact. Tlaib has lost neither her office, nor authority to introduce legislation, nor power to vote on proposed bills.
Yet the symbolic moment remains monumental nonetheless.
This publication is supported by dozens of readers among tens of thousands who read it. To receive new posts, subscribe for free. Paid subscriptions help expand my work and unlock bonus content.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..g_NEoFcTRvNFKYzVI5AGORW0BfkvVvsImRq-NtuFq3I?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=138710475)
Censuring a member is the last step available to Congress before expelling one, and taking that step towards the only Palestinian in Congress has exposed the deep bias that pervades it.
### **Islamophobia rising within --and well beyond--Congress**
It is not only within Congress that Islamophobia is rising.
Just yesterday, [the White House warned schools and colleges](https://substack.com/redirect/bc152263-28ab-419a-976b-d20055f9459a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across the United States about a rising tide of incidents including threats, harassment, and outright hate crimes. There have been [more examples](https://substack.com/redirect/f678a367-3cbf-4b3c-97a7-ab6f30bf1472?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than one could [possibly](https://substack.com/redirect/af9edee5-12bf-442b-8dda-51ff1da07186?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) count.
The White House even [launched](https://substack.com/redirect/5b0dfab4-a2ad-41f4-bcc3-f0698c1f2d29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a national strategy to counter Islamophobia this week, seemingly unaware of how frequently it has been and remains [a source of it](https://substack.com/redirect/1ffd29d6-3afd-4cc5-86bd-2b7cf6ce675a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) today.
Nor has bias been confined to [educational institutions](https://substack.com/redirect/61ba5adc-4d13-4a98-a024-33b2782a4dd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and the White House.
Less than a month ago, a 6-year old Palestinian-American child was [murdered by a deranged landlord](https://substack.com/redirect/11d8229d-6b1c-47ab-8228-e7766c2c95fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Illinois who also attacked and injured the child's mother. Last Friday, a university student at Stanford (where I graduated from law school 20 years ago) was hospitalized after a [hit & run attack](https://substack.com/redirect/56ecb5ab-235e-4013-8efd-255d9eec388b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by a driver who screamed "f*** you and your people" as he drove away.
These incidents point to broader patterns. Researchers have [documented](https://substack.com/redirect/966aa1af-34c9-4fb1-ae51-c194a631b1e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) pervasive anti-Muslim bias in employment across workplaces, beginning at the interview stage and stretching well beyond it. I spent years [documenting](https://substack.com/redirect/14dd7526-a2f1-4da1-ba8d-7714e2767b03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Islamophobia of government agencies, only to watch every elected member of Congress ignore our findings when they were published.
### **History rhymes**
In an earlier era, Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. [lamented](https://substack.com/redirect/01e148b3-9e36-4087-8a3e-78352e24c3b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the role of (what he described as) "the white moderate" in enabling injustice.
He observed that it's not just the acts of powerful institutional perpetrators that force marginalized people to bear the brunt of their actions, but crucially, the casual deference of well-meaning observers who decline to intervene. Some call for patience, others protect their positions of relative privilege, and others remain on an imaginary moral fence, all sharing a disappointing willingness to disregard pleas for solidarity from less fortunate voices reliant on their support.
The pattern observed by MLK continues today.
His observation explains everything from how racial marginalization persists in the United States today, to how presidents from both corporate political parties have overseen [fraudulent wars for corporate profit](https://substack.com/redirect/a2f43a01-c671-4891-8d88-874a4c014fc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) lasting as long as decades.

They also apply to Democrats in Congress.
It's not the right wing clowns in Congress--like Marjorie Taylor Green (R-GA) or Lauren Boebert (R-CO)--who are ultimately responsible for its worst legislative acts, but rather the legions of their seemingly more thoughtful colleagues who enable them. The mere fact that a censure petition [originally](https://substack.com/redirect/60d4c6d6-4ebb-40e6-a748-65ea05ed0aea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) launched by Marjorie Taylor Green was approved by Congress (albeit in a different form, after it was reintroduced by a different Republican) should be scandalous in itself.
The fact that 20 Democrats crossed the aisle to join their Republican colleagues in punching down and left at the one Palestinian in Congress--in the midst of a genocide in which they are nearly all complicit--is positively shameful. They today embody "the white moderate" whose complicity pained MLK.
### La-Dee-Da
The people in Tlaib's native country are enduring [an ongoing genocide grotesquely enabled by American weapons](https://substack.com/redirect/19f93917-0207-4fff-af18-9d5e76c42409?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Meanwhile, the White House is [reportedly obscuring its latest weapons shipments to Israel](https://substack.com/redirect/682d03c9-9f71-4b75-9b8e-a80752f3c66f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from public scrutiny, implausibly claiming that doing so would compromise security objectives.
Might it reflect a White House strategy to diminish Biden's culpability in predictable--and preventable--Israeli war crimes using them?
Congress is the only body poised to oversee or investigate the executive branch, or impose meaningful limits on its otherwise unrestrained global authority.
But Congress would rather bury its head in the sand than tolerate a truth teller in its midst. This degradation of the constitutional design is one way that our country's imperial [chickens have come home to roost](https://substack.com/redirect/9c0865b5-7f58-4c11-ad53-a5190cf3f57f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

| | With this November’s Election Day behind us, we wanted to reach out to say _**thank you**_. We’ll soon be digging into the numbers coming out of last night and using what we learn to continue empowering voters to make their voices heard. In particular, we’ll examine how Georgia’s massive voter suppression law, SB 202, impacted access to the ballot. **In the meantime, here’s what we know for sure: This election was a testament to the undeniable strength of our movement.** You went all out to help elect pro-voter candidates up and down the ballot, and we could not be more grateful. But our work to protect and expand the freedom to vote — particularly for young voters and people of color who’ve been historically shut out of the process — is far from over. We’ve now officially entered the 2024 election cycle. Tonight, 5 candidates will take the stage for the third Republican presidential debate — and we have to be ready for anything. No matter what they say to try and win votes, we know where they truly stand:
* As Governor of South Carolina, **Nikki Haley signed a burdensome and restrictive voter ID law** that the Department of Justice attempted to block, deeming that it was too discriminatory. She also **denounced Congress’ For the People Act** , which aimed to create federal standards to improve voting access for the first time since the Voting Rights Act of 1965, claiming that it was “unconstitutional and unwise.”
* As Governor of Florida, **Ron DeSantis has signed several extreme voter suppression bills into law** — including purging eligible voters from the rolls and creating a special law enforcement unit to investigate so-called “election crimes.” He also fought to pass a congressional map that intentionally eliminated a district historically held by Black Democrats, **which would have taken away critical representation for Black voters** from Tallahassee to Jacksonville.
* And while he might not be on stage tonight, we all know that **Donald Trump is the Election-Denier-in-Chief.** He’s been indicted for trying to overturn the results of the 2020 election by leading a criminal conspiracy to rob Georgia voters of their voice in our democracy. And his efforts to undermine our elections have **unleashed an unprecedented era of election denial, anti-voter laws, and attacks on our democracy** — all in service of delusional attempts to hold onto power by any means necessary.

We can’t let any of these candidates become president (again). clean_body: We’ll keep holding anti-voter politicians accountable — but we need your help to make it all possible. | | | With this November’s Election Day behind us, we wanted to reach out to say thank you. We’ll soon be digging into the numbers coming out of last night and using what we learn to continue empowering voters to make their voices heard. In particular, we’ll examine how Georgia’s massive voter suppression law, SB 202, impacted access to the ballot. In the meantime, here’s what we know for sure: This election was a testament to the undeniable strength of our movement. You went all out to help elect pro-voter candidates up and down the ballot, and we could not be more grateful. But our work to protect and expand the freedom to vote — particularly for young voters and people of color who’ve been historically shut out of the process — is far from over. We’ve now officially entered the 2024 election cycle. Tonight, 5 candidates will take the stage for the third Republican presidential debate — and we have to be ready for anything. No matter what they say to try and win votes, we know where they truly stand: As Governor of South Carolina, Nikki Haley signed a burdensome and restrictive voter ID law that the Department of Justice attempted to block, deeming that it was too discriminatory. She also denounced Congress’ For the People Act , which aimed to create federal standards to improve voting access for the first time since the Voting Rights Act of 1965, claiming that it was “unconstitutional and unwise.” As Governor of Florida, Ron DeSantis has signed several extreme voter suppression bills into law — including purging eligible voters from the rolls and creating a special law enforcement unit to investigate so-called “election crimes.” He also fought to pass a congressional map that intentionally eliminated a district historically held by Black Democrats, which would have taken away critical representation for Black voters from Tallahassee to Jacksonville. And while he might not be on stage tonight, we all know that Donald Trump is the Election-Denier-in-Chief. He’s been indicted for trying to overturn the results of the 2020 election by leading a criminal conspiracy to rob Georgia voters of their voice in our democracy. And his efforts to undermine our elections have unleashed an unprecedented era of election denial, anti-voter laws, and attacks on our democracy — all in service of delusional attempts to hold onto power by any means necessary. We can’t let any of these candidates become president (again). name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Ohio wants to be Michigan so bad
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=780%2E135344%2EpZVVo7)

Friend,
As a Michigander, I mean it when I say I have never been so proud of Ohio! Last night, Ohio voters turned out in droves to pass a ballot initiative that enshrined reproductive freedom into their state constitution (and another ballot proposal to legalize marijuana.)
Victory in Ohio last night continues a trend of Midwestern states rejecting extremist attempts to restrict abortion rights. First, Kansas last August. Then, our great state of Michigan last November, where we codified Roe. And in Michigan’s local elections last night, we saw the extreme, culture-war candidates lose to serious, pragmatic leaders of both parties, across our city councils and school boards.
But one thing is clear: Ohio may occasionally beat us in football, but they are THIRSTY for Michigan’s progress! And we love it! We’re still, ahem, beating them – our ballot initiative to codify Roe passed here in Michigan with 56.7% and Issue 1 passed in Ohio with 56.6% – but we’re thrilled to be neck-and-neck with our rival. Next up, Florida, Missouri, Pennsylvania, and Iowa either will have or are working to get their own Roe provisions on the ballot next year.
All in all, the Midwest had a great election night: In addition to this incredible news in Ohio, last night Democratic Governor Andy Beshear won re-election in Kentucky. Those not lucky enough to be Midwesterners also had a good night: Democrats in Virginia showed up in their local elections to keep the State Senate and flip the House – effectively blocking any attempts to pass an abortion ban in Virginia, and Pennsylvania expanded their Democratic majority in the Supreme Court.
Unfortunately, even in the commentary today, Republicans have made it clear at every level that overturning a federal right to abortion was just the beginning. There’s a pro-life rally at our capital in Michigan and a group of anti-choice organizations has filed a lawsuit to overturn the constitutional amendment to codify Roe that we passed last year. And they will certainly continue to fight to outlaw abortion across the country with statewide bans where they can – and ultimately a federal ban, superseding state law even in places where voters have made their voices clear.
**So as important a moment this is for Ohio, we need more than just state efforts to protect the right to abortion.** We need principled elected leaders at every level of government who will fight to protect these critical rights and codify Roe into federal law.
**[If you agree, I hope you join me in my campaign for Senate by chipping in today.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-nov23.RK33_Y&refcode=em231108-1-30&t=2&akid=780%2E135344%2EpZVVo7)**

body:
I am exceedingly grateful to all of our candidates and their campaign teams for running such incredible races, in many cases against tough odds.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/73043093/437205907/931971737?refcode=BLU-JANE-20231108-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI5NDg1MjhlLTg5N2UtZWUxMS04OTI1LTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=aH8yjbGCqFf6Ms4cPRpbprDJSBCRZk4zhjpux26HirU=)

| Hi, it’s Jane Fonda. I am reaching out with some exciting news – thanks to your support, our endorsed candidates in key races across the country are now on their way to elected office.

_**Here are some highlights:**_ **➡️ **In Virginia’s General Assembly election, 13 out of 14 of our endorsed candidates won their seats! As a result, Virginia Democrats now hold a majority in both the House and State Senate. This is a major win for protecting climate progress in Virginia and a major rebuke of Glenn Youngkin and the GOP’s plan to undermine progress on abortion, education, and voting rights.
---
| | _**Virginia House of Delegates Victories**_

Rozia Henson
Atoosa Reaser
Marty Martinez
Rodney Willett
Joshua Cole
Rae Cousins
Phil Hernandez

_**Virginia State Senate Victories**_

Lashrecse Aird
Schuyler VanValkenburg
Danica Roem
Russet Perry
Jennifer Carroll Foy
Saddam Salim

**Fairfax County Victories:**

Andres Jimenez, Fairfax County Board of Supervisors
Karl Frisch, Fairfax County School Board
---
**➡️ **In San Diego, Monica Montgomery Steppe became the first Black Woman elected to the San Diego County Board of Supervisors. **➡️ **In Minneapolis, Katie Cashman won the Minneapolis City Council Ward 7 race by 177 votes in the second & final round of ranked-choice voting. **➡️ **In Pennsylvania, 4 of the _**Luzerne United**_ slate for County Council were elected. Thanks to their hard work and dedication, the county council has avoided a worst-case scenario of complete GOP control.
| | _**Luzerne County Victories:**_

Brittany Stephenson
Jimmy Sabatino
Joanna Bryn Smith
Patty Krushnowski

_**Allegheny County Victory:**_

Sara Innamorato, Allegheny County Executive
---
I am exceedingly grateful to all of our candidates and their campaign teams for running such incredible races, in many cases against tough odds. In my time working with candidates here at the PAC, I’ve learned it takes a special kind of person to weather the storms that come with campaigning, and I hope you’ll join me in thanking them.

Last but certainly not least, I want to _**thank you.**_

Without you, we would not be able to provide the level of support that we do for our climate champions.

To everyone who contributed or volunteered their time, I hope you know how impactful your support truly is. Because of you, millions of people in Virginia, Pennsylvania, Minnesota, and California now have representatives, senators, councilmembers, executives, and supervisors who will fight for a livable future for all their communities.

And in many ways, we’re just getting started. I look forward to working with you in the next chapter of our work.

Onward,

I am reaching out with some exciting news – thanks to your support, our endorsed candidates in key races across the country are now on their way to elected office. Here are some highlights: ➡️ In Virginia’s General Assembly election, 13 out of 14 of our endorsed candidates won their seats! As a result, Virginia Democrats now hold a majority in both the House and State Senate. This is a major win for protecting climate progress in Virginia and a major rebuke of Glenn Youngkin and the GOP’s plan to undermine progress on abortion, education, and voting rights. | | Virginia House of Delegates Victories Rozia Henson Atoosa Reaser Marty Martinez Rodney Willett Joshua Cole Rae Cousins Phil Hernandez Virginia State Senate Victories Lashrecse Aird Schuyler VanValkenburg Danica Roem Russet Perry Jennifer Carroll Foy Saddam Salim Fairfax County Victories: Andres Jimenez, Fairfax County Board of Supervisors Karl Frisch, Fairfax County School Board ➡️ In San Diego, Monica Montgomery Steppe became the first Black Woman elected to the San Diego County Board of Supervisors. ➡️ In Minneapolis, Katie Cashman won the Minneapolis City Council Ward 7 race by 177 votes in the second & final round of ranked-choice voting. ➡️ In Pennsylvania, 4 of the Luzerne United slate for County Council were elected. Thanks to their hard work and dedication, the county council has avoided a worst-case scenario of complete GOP control. | | Luzerne County Victories: Brittany Stephenson Jimmy Sabatino Joanna Bryn Smith Patty Krushnowski Allegheny County Victory: Sara Innamorato, Allegheny County Executive I am exceedingly grateful to all of our candidates and their campaign teams for running such incredible races, in many cases against tough odds. Last but certainly not least, I want to thank you. Without you, we would not be able to provide the level of support that we do for our climate champions. body:
When reproductive freedom is on the ballot, reproductive freedom wins.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1810%2E4032634%2Ehp-yi2)
---
One thing’s already clear from yesterday’s elections: **when reproductive freedom is on the ballot, reproductive freedom wins.** Ohioans enshrined the right to an abortion in their state constitution, ensuring that an extreme six-week ban will not take effect. In Virginia, Democrats ran on abortion rights and flipped the House of Delegates while holding onto the Senate — which means the GOP governor won’t be able to pass the abortion ban on his wish list. Kentucky re-elected its Democratic governor, who attacked his Republican opponent’s anti-abortion extremism. And Democrats won a state Supreme Court race in Pennsylvania after — you guessed it — campaigning on defending abortion rights. You know, some cable news gurus have said Democrats shouldn’t talk so much about abortion. That it’s somehow a distraction from discussing the economy. But the American people understand that a family's well-being is inextricably linked to a family’s freedom. Abortion is a kitchen-table issue, and decisions about reproduction are also decisions about health and economic security. Ever since right-wing radicals on the Supreme Court overturned Roe, I’ve talked to so many people who’ve said, with a fierce determination, _I will not let someone else make that decision for me. They don't know me. They don't know my circumstances. They are not going to decide what happens to my life._ And at the ballot box yesterday, the American people made that determination clear. **Democrats can win more elections — in 2024 and beyond — by speaking out for what we believe in. By defending the right to an abortion and the freedom to set your own path in life. By campaigning against MAGA Republicans’ out-of-touch extremism.** **I’m running for re-election next year because I’m in this fight all the way. And I’m honored to fight by your side.** Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

Ever since right-wing radicals on the Supreme Court overturned Roe, I’ve talked to so many people who’ve said, with a fierce determination, I will not let someone else make that decision for me. They don't know me. They don't know my circumstances. They are not going to decide what happens to my life. And at the ballot box yesterday, the American people made that determination clear. Democrats can win more elections — in 2024 and beyond — by speaking out for what we believe in. By defending the right to an abortion and the freedom to set your own path in life. By campaigning against MAGA Republicans’ out-of-touch extremism. I’m running for re-election next year because I’m in this fight all the way. And I’m honored to fight by your side. body:
On that debate stage, I hope you saw in me the candidate who delivers the TRUTH. That an American revival is real and achievable.

| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---

| | [](http://trk.secureandprosper.)

**Fellow American,**

Another debate down, and the contrast between the other candidates and myself could not be more clear. We can continue to be a party that loses and lacks direction OR we can start taking on the dishonest media and the establishment marching us toward World War III. _**Nothing can stand in our way if we do this and unite under one flag and identity.**_

My direction is the **TRUTH.**

I'm running for President of these United States - not for foreign countries across the globe. The neocons of the past spent trillions, killed billions, and in the process profited from creating global chaos. _**You have my word, I will keep us out of World War III.**_

From securing our border, declaring independence from Communist China, and believing in an America ready to answer the challenges of the future, I'm ready to be a leader who restores the ideals our country was founded on.

[**Can you help me keep this momentum going and continue to show your support for the TRUTH?**](http://trk.secureandprosper.)

| | [** A CANDIDATE FOR
YOU AND AMERICA **](http://trk.secureandprosper.-iCf6dbTMvTjfdgBeoHw)
---
| [** ESTABLISHMENT
HACKS **](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
---

It's time for a new generation of leadership. The American people deserve a government that doesn't lie to us - about the origin of Covid, about Ukraine, about Hunter Biden, about Jan 6. and the Nashville transgender school shooter's manifesto. We can handle the **TRUTH.**

[Fellow American, give me liberty and give me TRUTH.](http://trk.secureandprosper.)

**Super PAC puppets. Politicians who are more interested in getting rich than serving the interests of the American people.** That's the system we need to break away from if we will ever get the spirit of America thriving again. Republicans or Democrats, it doesn't matter. The minute we can all stop playing the game the establishment has set for us - we can achieve great things together.

The American revival where we take pride in our national identity - founded on family, faith, patriotism, and hard work - is achievable. The great American dream is real. The America First 2.0 agenda my campaign is running on, belongs to _**you.**_

On that debate stage, I hope you saw in me the candidate who brings those ideas to life. I have laid out my plans for our national revival and took the attacks from the establishment hacks. Fellow American, with you on my side, I know that we cannot be beaten. [**Please consider a contribution and let's get a a victory movement in 2024.**](http://trk.secureandprosper.)

Thank you,

[](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
Vivek Ramaswamy

[** VICTORY MOMENT **](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
Last night, voters defied expectations across the country.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73045207/437213583/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWRkYmExYTctOTA3ZS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=c7Kz2JuvueFCobx4iyVFiQ1fbHyprkMZdJtAyZSu944=&emci=1c1b4ba0-907e-ee11-8925-00224832e811&emdi=5ddba1a7-907e-ee11-8925-00224832e811&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
Last night, key elections took place across the country, and the results defied the mainstream media and “expert” consensus that the sky was falling for Democrats.
Across the country, MAGA Republicans were defeated up and down the ballot.
From Iowa to Pennsylvania to Virginia, Courier’s network of nine newsrooms covered the most important issues in these elections, calling out misinformation and the right-wing bad actors pushing it.
We're going to explain how our local Courier teams provided critical coverage of yesterday's most important elections but first: [**Can you contribute $5 to keep our newsrooms up and running?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73045208/437213584/-542558358?refcode=em20231108&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWRkYmExYTctOTA3ZS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=c7Kz2JuvueFCobx4iyVFiQ1fbHyprkMZdJtAyZSu944=)
**Iowa School Board Races**
In the run-up to Election Day, our _Iowa Starting Line_ newsroom heavily focused coverage on ongoing school board races that featured far-right extremists from groups like ‘Moms of Liberty’ who sought to enact book bans, defund public schools, and pushed a ridiculous curriculum that white-washed American history:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73045209/437213585/-542558358?refcode=em20231108&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWRkYmExYTctOTA3ZS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=c7Kz2JuvueFCobx4iyVFiQ1fbHyprkMZdJtAyZSu944=)
With the _Iowa Starting Line_ sounding the alarm, voters surprised experts by rejecting Moms for Liberty candidates in Ankeny, Johnston, and Urbandale.
This is the journalism our democracy needs. We believe in providing quality, accessible journalism without hiding behind a paywall or subscription. But to keep this commitment, we need support from folks like you. [**So, if you can, please chip in $5 to support our _Iowa Starting Line_ team.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73045210/437213586/-542558358?refcode=em20231108&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWRkYmExYTctOTA3ZS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=c7Kz2JuvueFCobx4iyVFiQ1fbHyprkMZdJtAyZSu944=)
**Pennsylvania Supreme Court Race**
In the lead-up to a high-stakes Pennsylvania Supreme Court race, our newsroom _The Keystone_ broke the story that the Republican candidate, Carolyn Carluccio wiped her campaign website of her extreme, anti-abortion record in a last-minute effort to appeal to moderate voters:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73045211/437213587/-542558358?refcode=em20231108&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWRkYmExYTctOTA3ZS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=c7Kz2JuvueFCobx4iyVFiQ1fbHyprkMZdJtAyZSu944=)
Not only did our coverage feature heavily in political ads across the Commonwealth, it was cited in _The Philadelphia Inquirer’s_ endorsement of her Democratic rival, Daniel McCaffery.
McCaffery ultimately defeated Carluccio by six points.
Despite last night’s results, Pennsylvania is considered to be a key swing state that could decide the fate of the 2024 race.
Between now and then, _The Keystone_ will continue to serve as a resource for voters across the Commonwealth. [**By supporting our work, you can ensure that our team of journalists will have the resources they need to inform and engage communities across the state.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73045212/437213588/-542558358?refcode=em20231108&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWRkYmExYTctOTA3ZS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=c7Kz2JuvueFCobx4iyVFiQ1fbHyprkMZdJtAyZSu944=)
**Virginia State Legislative Races**
Lastly, in what was one of the most-watched elections, our _Dogwood_ newsroom in Virginia was among the first to call out Gov. Glenn Youngkin’s administration for a last-ditch illegal voter purge and heavily covered Youngkin’s promise to enact a restrictive 15-week abortion ban — which Virginians overwhelmingly _**did not support.**_
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/73045213/437213589/-542558358?refcode=em20231108&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWRkYmExYTctOTA3ZS1lZTExLTg5MjUtMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=c7Kz2JuvueFCobx4iyVFiQ1fbHyprkMZdJtAyZSu944=)
In the end, voters **rejected** Youngkin and MAGA Republicans, taking control of the general assembly and, ultimately, throwing a huge wrench in Youngkin’s promise to ban abortion in the Commonwealth.
Our innovative news model works, Peter. By focusing on the local issues voters care most about in their communities and correcting misinformation in real time, Courier Newsroom has the unique ability to make a difference in elections across the country.
With the 2024 election on the horizon, we want to grow and expand our work’s reach. But we can only do this with your support. Peter,
**We call on Congress to demand an IMMEDIATE ceasefire in Gaza, and the safe release of all hostages held by Hamas.**
More than 1,400 Israelis were killed and hundreds were taken hostage by Hamas in a horrific attack on October 7. We condemn Hamas’ inhumane acts against innocent civilians.
Israel's response and actions in Gaza and the collective punishment of Palestinians has involved bombardment of civilian areas and cutting off lifesaving resources to innocent people. Over 10,000 Palestinians, including over 4,000 children, have been killed.
Gaza has no water or power, and as hospitals fill, doctors lack medicine and supplies.
The international community is calling for help. The United Nations, Doctors without Borders, Amnesty International and many other humanitarian organizations have all called for a ceasefire.
The United States cannot allow this humanitarian disaster against civilians in Gaza to continue.
**We condemn any further violence. We bear a profound moral obligation to every child in this world to ensure they live in peace.**

clean_body: | | | Peter, We call on Congress to demand an IMMEDIATE ceasefire in Gaza, and the safe release of all hostages held by Hamas. More than 1,400 Israelis were killed and hundreds were taken hostage by Hamas in a horrific attack on October 7. We condemn Hamas’ inhumane acts against innocent civilians. Israel's response and actions in Gaza and the collective punishment of Palestinians has involved bombardment of civilian areas and cutting off lifesaving resources to innocent people. Over 10,000 Palestinians, including over 4,000 children, have been killed. Gaza has no water or power, and as hospitals fill, doctors lack medicine and supplies. The international community is calling for help. The United Nations, Doctors without Borders, Amnesty International and many other humanitarian organizations have all called for a ceasefire. The United States cannot allow this humanitarian disaster against civilians in Gaza to continue. We condemn any further violence. We bear a profound moral obligation to every child in this world to ensure they live in peace. ** Palestinians and Israelis have suffered the excruciating anguish of burying their children in graves. The laughter and happiness that should fill a child's memory have been replaced by the horrors of conflict, the sound of bombs, the grief and the trauma of war which can be long lasting. We implore our representatives to urgently call for the release of all hostages, a ceasefire, end the blockade, and ensure immediate humanitarian aid reaches the suffering population, especially the women and children. ** Thanks for your support. \- Derek Marshall for Congress is a Democrat running for Congress in California's 23rd District.
